abstract: A hand apparatus of a robot which is less likely to be damaged and can offer a reliable and effective gripping of a workpiece. The hand apparatus comprises a main frame which is mounted to a wrist member through a plurality of damper couplings. Pivotally mounted to the main frame are a pair of four-point-articulated link arms each having two arms extending parallel to each other. A sub-frame having a finger mounted thereon for pivotal movement in every direction is pivotally mounted to the leading end of the respective link arms. A pair of hydraulic cylinders are provided for moving the link arms in a gripping operation.
source_title: Hand apparatus of a robot

abstract: The invention discloses a visual guidance type omnidirectional mobile double-arm robot and an omnidirectional moving method thereof. The omnidirectional mobile double-arm robot comprises a vehicle body, an upper computer, a supporting framework, a depth camera, a first ultrasonic sensor module, a second ultrasonic sensor module, a third ultrasonic sensor module, a fourth ultrasonic sensor module, a first mechanical arm and a second mechanical arm, wherein the upper computer and the supporting framework are fixed to the vehicle body, the depth camera, the first mechanical arm and the second mechanical arm are arranged on the supporting framework, and the depth camera is electrically connected to the upper computer. The vehicle body comprises a chassis, a vehicle cover, a first direct current motor, a second direct current motor, a third direct current motor, a fourth direct current motor, a first motor drive module, a second motor drive module, a third motor drive module, a fourth motor drive module, a first coupler, a second coupler, a third coupler, a fourth coupler, a first omnidirectional wheel, a second omnidirectional wheel, a third omnidirectional wheel, a fourth omnidirectional wheel, a lower computer and a Bluetooth module. According to the robot and the omnidirectional moving method thereof, the working space range of the robot is expanded, the flexibility of the robot is improved, and the practical value is high.
source_title: Visual guidance type omnidirectional mobile double-arm robot and omnidirectional moving method thereof

abstract: The invention discloses a coordination task-oriented master-slave unified admittance control method for a two-arm robot, which comprises the following steps of: establishing a reference coordinate system and a transformation matrix between coordinate systems, and combining closed chain and open chain constraints to obtain a tail end expected movement track and a master-slave arm movement model of the two-arm robot; the resultant force borne by an object is decomposed and introduced into a grabbing matrix, an object dynamic equation in the coordinated movement process is obtained, admittance control is combined, trajectory parameters output by an admittance control algorithm are obtained, and a master-slave unified admittance control UAMSC algorithm is designed; and based on the expected motion trail of the tail end and the master-slave arm motion model, a UAMSC algorithm is applied, and a two-arm robot cooperative control strategy is established and executed for different tasks, so that the stability of the internal force of the system is kept under the conditions of man-machine cooperation and external force interference. According to the method, the requirements of man-machine cooperation and external force interference suppression in coordination task execution of the double-arm robot can be met, and the method can be applied to scenes such as collaborative carrying of the double-arm robot.
source_title: Coordination task-oriented master-slave unified admittance control method for two-arm robot

abstract: The invention discloses a control method for a magic cube solving robot based on two arms and four fingers, and relates to the field of robot control. According to the method, the step optimization problem of mechanical action recovery of the robot with the two-arm and four-finger structure in the magic cube recovery task can be solved, and the robot can be allowed to perform the mechanical action recovery task on any magic cube in a disordered state. When a task is completed, firstly, a key operation surface and an operation stage are defined, then conversion logic from the magic cube restoration step to the mechanical execution step is constructed, and an optimal restoration path is explored by integrating reset and adjustment stages of adjacent steps and utilizing symmetric plane conversion and selection of an execution strategy. Thirdly, a pruning function is introduced, future step cost is predicted based on historical data, and search space complexity is reduced; and finally, the optimization function is integrated into a search algorithm, a reduction sequence with the least mechanical step number is searched, and the reduction sequence is accurately executed by a controller so as to efficiently and accurately complete the magic cube recovery task.
source_title: Rubik cube solving robot control method based on two arms and four fingers

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of a robot, and in particular to a double-arm-cooperative robot. The double-arm-cooperative robot comprises a binocular vision component, an integrated control cabinet, a double-arm component and a movable platform; a power module, a control module, a communication module, a brake module, a main board and a rigid disc are arranged inside the integrated control cabinet; the binocular vision component comprises at least two cameras which are used for acquiring image information; the cameras are connected with a head vision board card; and the head vision board card is connected with the main board and is used for acquiring the image information and calculating three-dimensional geometrical information. The double-arm-cooperative robot provided by the invention is high in acquisition speed, accurate in location, simple and convenient to operate by virtue of more-anthropopathic setting and capable of improving the accuracy and flexibility of the action of double arms and greatly improving the performances of the robot.
source_title: Double-arm-cooperative robot

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of double-arm base optimization, in particular to a double-arm robot layout optimization method based on teaching learning, which comprises the following steps: step 1, recording teaching; step 2, DMP learning; 3, selecting a common track end point and generalizing the track; 4, selecting an expected layout mode; 5, designing a robot layout measurement index; step 6, optimizing an undetermined layout according to the indexes; 7, adjusting learning algorithm parameters, and generalizing a task track which is faster to execute; according to the double-arm robot platform layout optimization selection method, double-arm robot platform layout optimization selection can be accelerated, the task execution efficiency can be improved for a set task, and service faces double-arm platform construction of the set task.
source_title: Double-arm robot layout optimization method based on teaching learning

abstract: The invention provides a double-arm robot remote real-time control system and method based on virtual reality, and belongs to the technical field of mechanical arm teleoperation. The system comprises virtual reality equipment used for completing interaction between a human body and the double-arm robot, a simulation system of the virtual reality equipment, a video collection system used for collecting images of the double-arm robot, the double-arm robot, a computer and a software control subsystem. The method comprises the steps of experimental area planning, arm posture collection and experimental platform design, posture information transmission, control program design of the double-arm robot, virtual reality picture display and the like. The virtual reality technology is introduced into control of the mechanical arm, compared with a traditional control mode of an operating lever and a control panel, the control mode is faster and simpler. Meanwhile, the movement video of the double-arm robot is fed back to the virtual reality equipment in real time, an inexperienced operator is quite facilitated, a better man-machine interaction mode is achieved. The system is safer.
source_title: Double-arm robot remote real-time control system and method based on virtual reality

abstract: The invention discloses a double-arm robot multi-topological-structure workpiece sorting method based on grabbing prediction, and the method comprises the following steps: a robot controller sends an instruction, and reads an RGB-D image from a robot visual system; dividing the RGB-D image into an RGB image and a depth image, and performing standardization processing on the RGB image and the depth image; constructing a grabbing prediction dual-channel neural network and initializing network parameters; constructing a workpiece data set required by network training; respectively taking the RGB image and the depth image after standardization processing as input of a capture prediction dual-channel neural network; the grabbing prediction dual-channel neural network outputs the grabbable position of the workpiece; the grabbable position of the workpiece is converted from a camera coordinate system to a mechanical arm coordinate system; and the robot controller sends an instruction, the workpiece is grabbed according to the grabbable position, converted to the mechanical arm coordinate system, of the workpiece through a multi-process double-mechanical-arm cooperative grabbing control method, the workpiece is placed in a designated area, and sorting is completed. According to the invention, accurate sorting of various workpieces with different topological structures can be realized.
source_title: Double-arm robot multi-topological-structure workpiece sorting method based on grabbing prediction

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, provides a double-arm robot control method, device and equipment and a medium, can be applied to financial and medical health care service scenes, and can utilize multiple types of sensors to collect current environment data so as to train a visual language action model, so that the model preliminarily has basic generalization ability; a feature extraction module of a double-arm robot action decision model is utilized to dynamically extract multi-modal features of real-time environment information based on an attention mechanism, so that multi-modal feature representation adapting to a dynamic environment is quickly captured, the perceptibility of the model to a new environment is improved, and the generalization ability of the model is improved; and inputting the task target, the constraint condition and the multi-modal features obtained through analysis into a strategy network of the double-arm robot action decision model to obtain an action sequence of the double-arm robot, and controlling the double-arm robot to execute the action sequence so as to realize accurate understanding and decision making of tasks in a new environment, and improve the adaptability of the model to the new environment.
source_title: Double-arm robot control method, device, equipment and medium

abstract: The invention discloses a heavy-load double-arm industrial robot which is characterized in that a first-shaft assembly body is connected with a rotating seat, two large arms which are arranged left and right at an interval are connected between a second-shaft assembly body and a third-shaft assembly body, and a nitrogen cylinder is connected between each large arm and the rotating seat; the rear side of the three-shaft assembly is connected with a pull rod, the lower end of the pull rod is connected with a pull rod connecting shaft, the left end and the right end of the pull rod connecting shaft are connected with a first balance supporting plate and a second balance supporting plate respectively, and the front ends of the first balance supporting plate and the second balance supporting plate are connected to the lower ends of the two large arms respectively. The rear end of the first balance supporting plate and the rear end of the second balance supporting plate are both connected with balance load blocks, the three-axis assembly body is connected with a three-axis motor, and the two-axis assembly body comprises a two-axis motor, a first speed reducer and a second speed reducer. The first speed reducer and the second speed reducer are connected in series in a transmission mode, the two large arms are connected to the output mounting face of the first speed reducer and the output mounting face of the second speed reducer respectively, and single-motor driving and double-speed-reducer series transmission are achieved.
source_title: Heavy-load double-arm industrial robot

abstract: The invention discloses a path planning method and device for a double-arm robot, electronic equipment and a storage medium. Comprising the steps that first environment state information and equipment state information corresponding to the double-arm robot are input into a double-arm cooperative control model, and first control data of the double-arm robot are obtained; inputting the first control data, the first position information and the first environment state information corresponding to the double-arm robot into a path planning decision model to obtain a first path; under the condition that the judgment result of the first path is that the target operation requirement is not met, second control data output by the two-arm cooperative control model is obtained; and inputting second control data, second position information and second environment state information corresponding to the double-arm robot into the path planning decision model to obtain a second path, and performing operation demand judgment on the second path again until a target path meeting the target operation demand is obtained. The path planning efficiency and coordination are improved by constructing a closed-loop path planning and motion control coupling mechanism.
source_title: Path planning method and device of double-arm robot, electronic equipment and storage medium

abstract: The invention discloses a preschool education robot with a circuit protecting function. The preschool education robot with the circuit protecting function comprises a body, a head, a chassis, two armsand a drawer; the head is arranged above the body; the chassis is arranged at the bottom of the body; the two arms are positioned on the two sides of the body; the drawer is arranged in the body; a first movement device is arranged between the body and the head; a display and a camera area arranged on the head; a circuit board is arranged in the head; a single chip microcomputer and a power supply module are arranged on the circuit board; the display, the camera and the power supply module are all connected with the single chip microcomputer; and the power supply module comprises a first direct-current power supply, a first resistor, a first capacitor, a three-terminal voltage regulator, a second capacitor, an eighth resistor, a second resistor, a ninth resistor, a first triode, a fifth resistor, a second triode, a third resistor, an integrated operational amplifier, a fourth resistor, a third capacitor, a sixth resistor, a seventh resistor and a second direct-current power supply. The preschool education robot with the circuit protecting function is simple in circuit structure, low in cost and convenient to maintain; and the safety and the reliability of the circuit are high.
source_title: Preschool education robot with circuit protecting function

abstract: The invention discloses a multi-base station laser tracker collaborative re-location double-arm robot testing method and device. The method comprises the following steps that target point space coordinates are acquired; an expression of after-location point coordinates is obtained according to before-re-location point coordinates; a linear EIV mode is Constructed; a Lagrange extremum condition expression is constructed according to the linear EIV model; and a partial derivative is calculated for all components in the Lagrange extremum condition expression, a current to-be-calculated parametervector is obtained by taking the partial derivative as zero, the current to-be-calculated parameter vector is taken as an initial to-be-calculated parameter vector and returning and executing the stepfour are performed, a final to-be-calculated parameter vector is output until the difference between the current to-be-calculated parameter vector and a to-be-calculated parameter vector obtained inthe last iteration is less than a preset value, and the after-location point coordinates are obtained according to the final to-be-calculated parameter vector. The method has the advantage that coordinate systems of a multi-base station laser tracker are unified by the laser tracker collaborative re-location method.
source_title: Multi-base station laser tracker collaborative re-location double-arm robot testing method and device

abstract: The present invention relates to a workability analysis method of a two-arm robot. The purpose of the present invention is to select an initial angle of an arm and an interval of both arms that have optimal workability in a hydraulic driven two-arm robot with a limited range of joint motion of robot arms, and to compare workability of two-arm robots with different joint arrangements and link lengths of robot arms. To this end, the workability analysis method of a two-arm robot comprises the following steps of: (a) calculating the volume (V_total) of the entire working space of both arms (S10); (b) calculating the volume (V_common) of an area in which a working space of each arm overlaps (S20); (c) calculating PTCWA by the V_total calculated in the step S10 and the V_common calculated in the step S20 (S30); (d) selecting an initial angle of an arm and an interval of both arms that have optimal workability by the PTCWA calculated in the step S30 (S40); (e) calculating the effective length L of robot arms (S50); (f) calculating a performance index Q by the PTCWA calculated in the step S30 and the effective length L of the robot arms calculated in the step S50 (S60); and (g) comparing performances of two-arm robots with different joint arrangements and link lengths by the performance index Q calculated in the step S60 (S70).
source_title: Workability Analysis Method of Two Arm Robot and Robot Having Two Arms Using the Same

abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To minimize a footprint when a hand is reversed, to prevent a rise of circuit board path line and furthermore to enable easy application even to a double-arm robot. SOLUTION: A driving device of robot hand 6 is the driving device for a movable robot hand 6 that holds a thin circuit board (glass circuit board 8) and has a reversing mechanism 7 that rotates the robot hand 6 around the horizontal axis 9 that is orthogonal with the hand longitudinal direction.
source_title: Driving gear of manipulator

abstract: The present invention introduces a robot gripper and a control method thereof. The robot gripper comprises: upper and lower contact parts arranged on the end of both robot arms, coming in contact with the top and bottom surfaces of a weight in gripping, and formed as a spherical shape with the constant radius; sensor parts arranged in the upper and lower contact parts to measure vertical or horizontal pressing force applied to the upper or lower contact part in gripping; and a control part for obtaining the barycentric coordinates of the weight using the vertical and horizontal distance between the end of the both arms when the weight is gripped, the vertical and horizontal pressing force components measured by the sensor parts, and the height of the weight. [Reference numerals] (700) Control part
source_title: GRIPPPER OF ROBOT AND METHOD FOR CONTROLLING THE SAME

abstract: The invention discloses a novel mobile type double-arm robot. The novel mobile type double-arm robot includes wheel type chassis (1), supporting frames (2), a vehicle body movement assembly (3), electric driving body rotation assemblies (4), hydraulic leg lifting assemblies (2), a vehicle body (6); two wheel type chassis (1) are provided and are mounted at the bottom of the vehicle body movement assembly (3); the vehicle body (6) is mounted on the vehicle body movement assembly (3), so that the vehicle body (6) can move on the vehicle body movement assembly (3); and the vehicle body (6) is provided with a visual information collection device (7) and robot arm assemblies (8). The novel mobile type double-arm robot of the invention integrates the advantage of high speed of a fast wheel-type device and the advantage of obstacle surmounting ability of a leg-type device and can quickly enter a dangerous area. The novel mobile type double-arm robot, based on the vehicle body movement assembly and the double six-degree-of-freedom manipulators, can replace workers to perform complicated task. The operation space of the novel mobile type double-arm robot is large; and the work ability of the novel mobile type double-arm robot is strong.
source_title: Novel mobile type double-arm robot

abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent robot practical training platform for solving a magic cube, and belongs to the technical field of robot application. The intelligent robot practical training platform for solving the magic cube comprises a mounting table, a double-arm cooperation robot, a camera mechanism and two magic cube placing bases, wherein an electrical element and a control system areinstalled below the mounting table; the double-arm cooperation robot comprises a robot mounting frame, a double-arm cooperation robot body and two tail end grabbing arms, the robot mounting frame isinstalled on the mounting table, the robot mounting frame is of a hollow tubular structure, and the inner of the robot mounting frame is used for wiring; two movable arms of the double-arm cooperationrobot body are symmetrically installed on the robot mounting frame, and the two tail end grabbing arms are symmetrically installed on two output ends of the double-arm cooperation robot body; the camera mechanism is installed at the upper end of the robot mounting frame, the two magic cube placing bases are installed on the upper end face of the mounting table, and the two-arm cooperation robot body is of two six-axis series-connection robots with the same structure; and the six-axis series-connection robots are modular robots. According to the intelligent robot practical training platform, the magic cube can be solved and the adaptability is relatively high.
source_title: Intelligent robot practical training platform for solving magic cube

abstract: PURPOSE: To perform an exact follow-up operation in a double-arm robot in which a slave robot performs a follow-up operation for a main robot. CONSTITUTION: A main robot control part 44 outputs target location data from a data transmission part 15 to the data reception part 25 of a slave robot control part 55. The slave robot control part 55 receives target location data In an offset amount addition part 27, prescribed offset amount is added to target location data. Based on the added data, a slave robot is made to perform the follow-up operation for a main robot. At this time, the processing start of target location data is delayed in the delay processing part 41 of a main robot control part 44. Subsequently, the processing of an interpolation part 12 is started in timing with the processing start in the interpolation processing part 22 of the slave robot.
source_title: DOUBLE-ARM ROBOT CONTROLLER

abstract: The invention discloses a dual-arm apple picking and round classified collecting robot which comprises an autonomous movable platform. A robot body is installed at the center of the upper portion of the autonomous movable platform. A binocular vision sensor mechanism is installed on the top of the robot body. A fruit conveying and classified collecting system matched with the robot body is arranged on the front side of the robot body. A storage battery pack is arranged on the autonomous movable platform. A central controller is installed at the upper portion of the storage battery pack. The storage battery pack provides power for all motors and sensors and a central control unit on the robot body and the autonomous movable platform. The central control unit is the control center of the whole robot and controls all the electrical apparatus elements to work. The robot is high in adaptability, flexible in movement, safe, reliable and compact in structure and has the apple picking and classified collecting capacity.
source_title: Dual-arm apple picking and round classified collecting robot

abstract: The invention provides a double-arm manipulator device integrated with multiple sensors and a cooperative compliant operation method of the double-arm manipulator device. The double-arm manipulator device comprises the multiple sensors, a control circuit and a robot. The control circuit is arranged on the robot; the robot comprises a robot gripper; the multiple sensors are arranged on fingers of the robot gripper and simulate the touch sensing function of the fingers of a person; the multiple sensors sense a target object to obtain touch sensing information; and the control circuit controls the robot fingers to output preset force according to the touch sensing information so as to carry out smooth operation on the target object. According to the double-arm robot arm device, the human body structure is designed in a bionic mode, the fingers are integrated with multiple flexible sensors, the touch sensing function that the fingers of a person sense pressure and temperature can be simulated, and real-time feedback is achieved in the operation process.
source_title: Double-arm manipulator device integrated with multiple sensors and collaborative compliant operation method of double-arm manipulator device

abstract: The invention discloses a selling double-arm robot which comprises a robot body, a control device arranged in the robot body, selling operation double arms connected with the robot body and selling tail end executers arranged at the tail ends of the operation double arms. The control device controls the selling operation double arms and the selling tail end executers to execute selling operation.The invention further discloses an automatic selling system which comprises the selling double-arm robot and a selling square bin, and selling equipment is arranged in the selling square bin. The selling double-arm robot operates the selling equipment to execute the selling operation. By means of the selling double-arm robot, the selling operation double arms are adopted for executing the sellingaction correspondingly, a double arm cooperative operation manner in a complex selling scene is achieved, the selling double-arm robot is suitable for operation of different pieces of selling equipment, flexibility of the operation of selling diversified goods is improved, and the requirements of diversified selling scenes are met.
source_title: Selling double-arm robot and automatic selling system

abstract: The invention relates to a high-adaptability double-arm heavy-load operation robot. A mechanical arm control device comprises a hydraulic mechanical arm, a mechanical arm supporting piece, a hydraulic driving system, a pump station shell and two circular rotating tables. The crawler leg wheel control device comprises a crawler leg composite walking mechanism, an auxiliary wheel supporting mechanism and triangular crawler wheels, the crawler leg composite walking mechanism comprises walking hydraulic cylinders hinged to the four corners of the chassis mechanism and a bridge plate, and a hinge connector with the free end hinged to a piston rod of the corresponding walking hydraulic cylinder is arranged at the bent position of the middle of the bridge plate. A steering mechanism is fixedly connected to the bridge plate connecting piece, and a walking motor is fixedly installed on the side, facing the triangular crawler wheels, of the steering mechanism. The auxiliary wheel supporting mechanism comprises a supporting piece fixed to the lower portion of the chassis mechanism, a supporting hydraulic cylinder with the two ends hinged to the supporting piece and an auxiliary wheel rotationally connected to the bottom of the supporting piece. The problems that in the obstacle crossing or step climbing process of an existing heavy-load operation robot, operability is not high, and reliability is not high are solved.
source_title: High-adaptability double-arm heavy-load operation robot

abstract: The invention discloses a method and equipment for controlling a double-arm robot to automatically grind crystal materials and a medium, belongs to the field of experiments for controlling robots to make crystal materials, and is used for a double-arm robot grinding system.The method comprises the steps that 1, the double-arm robot is controlled to move to a grinding platform, and a camera is used for obtaining mortar pose information to locate the position of a mortar; step 2, acquiring a color distribution image of a crystal in the mortar by using a camera to judge subsequent operation, and if the grinding is judged to be stopped, executing step 5; if the operation is determined to be gathering operation, executing the step 3, and if the operation is determined to be grinding operation, executing the step 4; 3, a slave arm of the double-arm robot is controlled to gather the crystals in the mortar, and the step 2 is executed after gathering operation is finished; 4, a slave arm of the double-arm robot is controlled to fix the mortar, a main arm conducts grinding operation on the crystals in the mortar, and the step 2 is executed after grinding operation is finished; and 5, the double-arm robot is controlled to stop the grinding task. According to the method, the crystal grinding efficiency and accuracy can be improved.
source_title: Method and equipment for controlling double-arm robot to automatically grind crystal material and medium

abstract: The invention provides a double-arm magic cube solving robot and a restoring method thereof. The double-arm magic cube solving robot is mainly composed of magic cube solving mechanical arms, a robot body mechanism, an end effector and a control box attached to a robot body. Each mechanical arm main body part is mainly composed of a closed-loop stepping motor, a coupler, an air slip ring, a zero setting code disc and a U-shaped photoelectric switch. Through an upper computer control program programmed based on Python, a plurality of cameras and a magic cube regularly rotated by the mechanical arms are adopted for color collection, Euclidean distance and edge detection are adopted, six colors of the six faces of the magic cube are accurately recognized, and Gamma nonlinear correction is used to reduce exposure and improve brightness. According to the magic cube solving robot technology, a high-quality preliminary embedded talent can be cultivated through complete set of mechanical structure design, circuit design and manufacturing and program design control. Various technologies, especially color recognition, can be applied to various industrial and agricultural activities such as part detection, food quality detection and crop picking.
source_title: Double-arm magic cube solving robot and restoring method thereof

abstract: The invention discloses a robot capable of linearly and radially stretching and retracting, and relates to the technical field of robots. The robot comprises a machine base, a large arm and a second arm, wherein the machine base is of a concave structure, a mounting groove is formed in the upper surface of the machine base, a first motor is fixedly arranged on the inner bottom surface of the machine base, the output end of the first motor is fixedly connected with a first rotating synchronous wheel through a coupler, and the first rotating synchronous wheel is located in the mounting groove. According to the robot, the large arm and the machine base are connected through a rotating shaft, the large arm and the second arm are connected through a further rotating shaft and driven by one motor through a synchronous wheel and a synchronous belt, the large arm is arranged on a bearing of the machine base and is driven by another motor to complete a plane joint type robot which rotates around the center of the base, the two arms are driven to rotate at the same time through the rotation of one motor and the connection of the synchronous belt and thesynchronous wheel, the length and the transmission ratio of the two arms only need to meet a certain motion relation, and then any linear motion of an end effector in the working space of the end effector at the rotating center can be realized.
source_title: Robot capable of linearly and radially stretching and retracting

abstract: The invention provides an end effector for carrying wafers, a double-arm robot and a four-arm robot. A wafer upper mounting groove and a wafer lower mounting groove are formed in the top surface and the bottom surface of an effector main body respectively; and the wafer upper mounting groove and the wafer lower mounting groove are symmetrically distributed up and down relative to the thickness center line of the actuator main body, so that the end actuator used for carrying the wafer can be universally used on left and right mechanical arms without being limited by a double-cavity structure of equipment, and unified manufacturing and unified maintenance of the end actuator are facilitated.
source_title: End effector for conveying wafer, double-arm robot and four-arm robot

abstract: The invention relates to a width-adjustable armpit supporting flexible double arm structure used for a nursing robot. The width-adjustable armpit supporting flexible double arm structure comprises a chest support and two armpit supporting flexible arms, wherein the two armpit supporting flexible arms are symmetrically arranged at the two ends of the chest support in the left-right direction, and the structures of the two armpit supporting flexible arms are completely the same. Each armpit supporting flexible arm comprises an armpit supporting large arm, an armpit supporting small arm, an electric push rod, a chest support connecting piece, a width adjusting upper pressing block, a width adjusting lower pressing block, a transmission part and spring plates, wherein the front end of the armpit supporting large arm is connected with the rear end of the armpit supporting small arm through a transmission part, and the rear end of the armpit supporting large arm is connected with the chest support connecting piece through the upper layer and lower layer of spring plates. The structure is provided with a flexible joint so that the structure can be more suitable for serving people. The mechanical arms are provided with people embracing joints so that the phenomenon that people disengage from the machine and are injured in the people embracing process is prevented, in addition, the people embracing joints are provided with sensors, and therefore the embracing force can be fed back for control.
source_title: Width-adjustable armpit supporting flexible double arm structure used for nursing robot

abstract: The invention provides a double-arm robot. The double-arm robot comprises a base, a speed reducing mechanism assembled on the base and two mechanical arms. The speed reducing mechanism synchronously drives the two mechanical arms to rotate. The two mechanical arms are detachably and fixedly connected with the speed reducing mechanism. The included angle between the two mechanical arms is adjustable. It can be seen from the description that the two mechanical arms are installed on one speed reducing mechanism, the usage amount of speed reducers is reduced, and therefore the manufacturing cost is reduced; and the included angle between the two mechanical arms can be adjusted, multi-angle and multi-station application can be achieved in combination with different application program point positions, and the production efficiency is improved.
source_title: Double-arm robot

abstract: The invention provides a recursive robot two-arm collaborative operation path planning method, which comprises the following steps of: dividing a complete operation process into a plurality of sections of linear tracks, and performing path planning on segmentation points on the plurality of sections of linear tracks based on a path planning rule, calculating a tool tail end pose corresponding to the segment point of each non-reference pose based on the reference pose under the tool coordinate system; according to the size of the tool, the tail end pose of the tool is converted into the tail end pose of a robot arm for clamping the tool; and performing tracking control on the two arms of the robot based on the tail end poses of the robot arms corresponding to the segment points, so as to realize collaborative operation of the two arms of the robot. According to the method, robot actions are planned and designed into recursion processes, each recursion process has a reference pose, conversion from a tool pose to a robot pose is completed based on the reference poses, and therefore collaborative operation of the two arms of the robot is achieved.
source_title: Recursive robot double-arm collaborative operation path planning method

abstract: The robot with the emotion accompanying function comprises a robot lower body and a head, a circuit board is arranged in the robot lower body, the head is arranged at the top end of the robot lower body, a display screen is arranged at the top end of the front end of the head, and an eye display position is arranged in the display screen. A second reserved groove is formed in the top end of the lower robot body, a reserved opening is formed in one side of the lower robot body, a first reserved groove is formed in one side of the interior of the lower robot body, and an adjusting mechanism for assisting robot arms to swing is arranged in the first reserved groove. According to the robot with the emotion accompanying function, parts such as reserved openings are arranged, a first driving motor is turned on, a first connecting shaft is driven to rotate, and an arm fixedly connected with the outside in a sleeving mode can be driven to rotate, so that the whole robot is more flexible, vivid and interesting, and the problem that two arms are not convenient to swing is solved.
source_title: Robot with emotion accompanying function

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of education robots, and particularly discloses an education robot and classroom teaching control method and system. The system comprises a multi-media double-arm education robot, a multi-media server, a multi-media student end, and a multi-media teacher end. The multi-media double-arm education robot comprises a robot body, a multimedia communication module, a multimedia acquisition module, a multi-media information processing module, a teaching module and a state analysis module. The multi-media teacher end and the multi-media student end are used for sending teaching mode instructions to the multi-media communication module, and the teaching mode instructions comprise a classroom teaching mode and a classroom tutoring mode; the classroom teaching mode comprises a teacher main speaking mode, a robot auxiliary mode and a robot main speaking mode; and in the teacher speaking mode, the state analysis module is used for analyzing and feeding back the learning conditions of students, and the teaching module counseles and prompts the students based on the learning conditions of the students. By adopting the technical scheme of the invention, the interaction in classroom teaching can be more efficient.
source_title: Education robot and classroom teaching control method and system

abstract: Disclosed are a force guidance telerobotic system and control method based on a dual-arm collaborative potential field. A real-time pose of a tool center point of each of the two robotic arms is obtained using a robotic arm kinematic model, and checking is performed to determine whether a shortest distance dp-s,i between a target object and a workspace boundary of each of the two robotic arms is lower than a threshold Ds; a dual-arm symmetric collaboration strategy will be adopted when higher than the threshold; a single-arm primary collaboration strategy will be adopted when lower than the threshold; and a coordination factor δi of each of the robotic arms is determined according to the collaboration strategy; the dual-arm collaborative potential field is constructed according to the collaboration factor, a distance between the target object and the tool center point and a position of obstacle.
source_title: FORCE GUIDANCE TELEROBOTIC SYSTEM AND CONTROL METHOD BASED ON DUAL-ARM COLLABORATIVE POTENTIAL FIELD

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of double-arm robot application, and discloses a double-arm robot base coordinate system calibration method which comprises the following steps: changing different poses of tools at the tail end of a first mechanical arm and the tail end of a second mechanical arm in a double-arm robot for multiple times; calibration calculation is conducted on the relative pose relation of the base coordinate system of the first mechanical arm and the base coordinate system of the second mechanical arm; and the calibration calculation results of the first mechanical arm and the second mechanical arm are verified. The method can be used for human tumor laser ablation, and the obtained calibration result is accurate.
source_title: Double-arm robot base coordinate system calibration method and device

abstract: The invention discloses a dual-arm support rehabilitation training robot and an operation method of the dual-arm support rehabilitation training robot. The dual-arm support rehabilitation training robot comprises a crawler type walking machine, a base, a lifting screw mechanism, a manipulator part and a counterweight mechanism, wherein the manipulator part comprises shoulder joints, rotary joints, elbow joints and wrist joints, wherein each joint comprises a motor, a harmonic reducer and an output end. By adopting the dual-arm support rehabilitation training robot, the rehabilitation training of three-linear degree-of-freedom and two-rotational degree-of-freedom on hips of a human body can be realized in a gait training process; physiological movements of the hips in the gait training process can be highly simulated to effectively enhance the rehabilitation training effect.
source_title: Dual-arm support rehabilitation training robot and operation method thereof

abstract: The invention relates to a two-arm robot coordinated motion planning method with an anti-noise characteristic. The two-arm robot coordinated motion planning method comprises the following steps that 1, a two-arm robot kinematics equation based on a relative Jacobian matrix is established; 2, a coordinated motion planning scheme in the noise environment is constructed by combining the requirements of the double-arm robot; step 3, performing discretization processing on the scheme by adopting a multi-point difference formula; 4, designing a high-precision coordinated motion planning scheme with an anti-noise characteristic according to the discretized scheme; 5, calculating based on the high-precision coordinated motion planning scheme to obtain a joint angle solution for planning coordinated motion of the two-arm robot; and 6, the robot controller drives each joint of the two arms to move according to the joint angle solution, so that the two-arm robot accurately and effectively completes the set coordination planning task. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages that the two-arm robot can still accurately and effectively complete the set coordination planning task under the condition of noise interference, and the like.
source_title: Two-arm robot coordinated motion planning method with anti-noise characteristic

abstract: The invention discloses a calibration method for a base coordinate system of an obliquely-installed redundant double-arm robot, and the method comprises the steps: firstly building a world coordinate system, and determining a homogeneous transformation matrix of the world coordinate system under a laser tracker coordinate system through a laser tracker measurement system with higher precision; then the robots and the laser tracker are controlled to collect data, and a homogeneous transformation matrix of a base coordinate system of each robot under a world coordinate system is solved through coordinate transformation; and finally, the relative pose relation of the base coordinate system of the redundant double-arm robot and the relative pose relation of the base coordinate system of each single-arm robot and the world coordinate system are obtained, unification of the base coordinate system of the redundant double-arm robot installed in an inclined mode and the world coordinate system is achieved, and calibration of the base coordinate system of the redundant double-arm robot is completed. The calibration method is easy to operate, high in calibration efficiency and suitable for calibration of the double-robot base coordinate system of the obliquely-installed SRS configuration, meanwhile, the precision of the laser tracker is high, and the precision of obtained calibration data is high.
source_title: Base coordinate system calibration method for obliquely-installed redundant double-arm robot

abstract: The invention provides a multi-task operation coordinated motion control method for a double-arm robot. The method comprises the steps that environment information and target information of the double-arm robot and the current state of the double-arm robot are acquired; based on the two-arm robot model and the operated object model, establishing a constrained multi-body system model composed of the two-arm robot and an operation object; according to the difference of operation objects and operation tasks, control evaluation objective functions are established respectively, the constrained multi-body system model is adopted as a prediction model, a model prediction control method for multi-task operation of the two-arm robot is established, and two-arm robot joint control torque enabling the objective functions to be optimal is generated; force and torque information between the double-arm robot and an operation object is measured in real time through a tail end sensor and serves as feedback income, and the actual joint control torque of the double-arm robot is calculated through an optimization method based on quadratic programming; and the two-arm operation optimal joint torque is applied to an operation task of the two-arm robot.
source_title: Coordinated motion control method for multi-task operation of double-arm robot

abstract: The industrial robot has a base which supports a first arm (3) rotatable in a horizontal plane, and a first horizontal end of the first arm forms the rotary centre. A second arm (11) is supported by the other longitudinal end (3a) of the first arm. A rotary axis adjusted in a vertical direction is arranged at a longitudinal end of the second arm.A second arm drive unit rotates the second arm and is so fitted in the rotation centre of the first arm that a rotation relative to the base is prevented. An axis core is provided for location of the first and second arm so that the two arms are freely rotatable. A device (100) is incorporated for maintaining the angle position of the core shaft and holding the axis core relatively to the base at a constant angle.
source_title: Industrial robot

abstract: The invention discloses a double-arm collaborative robot based on a six-degree-of-freedom mechanical arm. Comprising a pair of mechanical arms, a mechanical clamping jaw, a robot waist and a shoulder. Each joint of the two arms of the robot is driven by a stepping motor, various transmission modes such as a belt wheel and a chain wheel are matched to drive each joint to move, six degrees of freedom in a three-dimensional space can be achieved, and stable and accurate movement of the mechanical arm is achieved; the waist part of the mechanical arm has a rotational degree of freedom, so that the double-arm working space of the mechanical arm can be increased; the shoulder part is located between the waist part and the two arms of the mechanical arm and forms an included angle of 30 degrees with the horizontal plane, so that the structure of the mechanical arm is more attractive while it is guaranteed that the size of the cooperation space of the two arms is appropriate; a pneumatic clamping jaw is installed on an actuator at the tail end of the mechanical arm, and small objects can be grabbed. The device is safe, efficient, convenient, practical and novel, the working efficiency can be improved in fixed-point grabbing, sorting and placing of medical reagents or samples, and the good market application prospect is achieved.
source_title: Double-arm cooperative robot based on six-degree-of-freedom mechanical arm

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robot automatic assembly, and provides a robot automatic step-by-step bolt assembly method and system and a double-arm robot. The method comprises the following steps of driving a first mechanical arm to clamp a pin to a first preassembly point located in a first mechanical arm base coordinate system; driving a second mechanical arm to clamp a pin seat with an inlet into a second preassembly point located in a second mechanical arm base coordinate system; obtaining inlet three-dimensional information of the inlet in the second machine arm base coordinate system when the pin seat is positioned at the second preassembly point; continuously detecting multi-dimensional force information of a pin wall on the pin seat in the second mechanical arm base coordinate system; and driving a first preassembly point of the first mechanical arm to start to assemble the pin into the pin seat step by step according to the three-dimensional information of the inlet and the multi-dimensional force information, the capability of automatically grabbing the pin seat by the mechanical arms and the capability of assembling the pin and the pin seat step by step into a bolt in the process of continuously obtaining information are improved, and the efficiency of double-arm automatic step-by-step bolt assembling is improved.
source_title: Robot automatic step-by-step bolt assembly method and system and double-arm robot

abstract: An arm type robot for transporting a substrate is provided to reinforce tension of a chain installed to an arm by employing a tension control unit including a tension control bar with a sprocket and a control member. An arm type robot for transporting a substrate includes two arms. Each arm comprises an arm frame(102), driving and driven gears(122,124), a chain(126), a tension control bar(132), and a control unit(142). The arm frame has upper and lower surfaces(104,106) and lateral surfaces, and defines the inner space. The driving and driven gears are separated from each other in the inner space and fixed to first and second link shafts(112,114) attached to two ends of the arm frame. The chain connects the driving gear with the driven gear in the inner space. One end of the tension control bar is rotatably attached to the inner space and a chain sprocket(134) is attached to the other end of the tension control bar and engaged with the chain between the driving gear and the driven gear. The control unit pushes the chain sprocket toward the chain to increase tension of the chain. The control member includes a bolt(144) and a spring(146).
source_title: arm type robot for transporting substrate

abstract: The present invention relates to an assembly device of a dual arm robot. More specifically, the assembly device of a dual arm robot comprises: a dual arm robot (100) provided in an assembly process line of a cylinder head (10); and a gripper (200) mounted on the dual arm robot (100) to assemble a component for a cylinder head to the cylinder head (10), thereby reducing production costs as automated operation is possible by using the dual arm robot (100) to reduce personnel, improving quality by preventing a problem with respect to an incorrect assembly and a heterogeneous assembly due to an error of a worker from being generated, and assembling an ignition plug, a valve, and a spring in the cylinder head with the dual arm robot (100). Thus, working convenience and efficiency may be increased.
source_title: ASSEMBLY DEVICE OF DUAL ARM ROBOT

abstract: The invention provides a double-arm reciprocating swing device of a model display robot, and relates to the technical field of display robots. Comprising a left arm and a right arm which are connected through a driving mechanism. The driving mechanism is composed of a driving part, a gear motor, two connecting rod assemblies, two rotating assemblies and two flange assemblies. The connecting rod assembly comprises cam connecting rods, a transmission connecting rod and a swing arm connecting rod, the two cam connecting rods are connected to output shafts on the two sides of the gear motor respectively and are arranged in the vertical direction, and the other ends of the cam connecting rods are sequentially connected with the transmission connecting rod and the swing arm connecting rod; the rotating assembly comprises a rotating shaft and a coupler, the swing arm connecting rod is hinged to one end of the rotating shaft and drives the rotating shaft to rotate, the other end of the rotating shaft is connected with the coupler, the coupler is connected with the flange assemblies, and the two flange assemblies are fixedly connected with the inner end faces of the left arm and the right arm respectively. Multiple connecting rods are in parallel transmission, friction force and abrasion are small, single-motor driving is achieved, left-right synchronization is achieved, and the swing angle is stable and reliable.
source_title: Double-arm reciprocating swing device of model display robot

abstract: A manually taught robot convenient to be taught and easy to operate. The robot comprises a main controller (6) and at least one joint (1-5). The joint (1-5) comprises two arms (11, 12; 12, 22; 22, 32; 32, 42; 42, 52) and a drive mechanism (13; 23; 33; 43; 53). The drive mechanism comprises a servo motor (131; 231; 331; 431; 531), a driver (132; 232; 332; 432; 532) and an encoder (133; 233; 333; 433; 533). The main controller (6) is electrically connected to each of the drivers (132; 232; 332; 432; 532), and an output of each of the encoders (133; 233; 333; 433; 533) is connected to the main controller (6). Also disclosed is a method for manually teaching a robot. The method comprises: upon learning, the robot enters into a torque mode and is driven to move according to a desired track, and a main controller stores learning output values of each of the encoders at each learning time or when each learning period goes by; upon resetting, the servo motor is in a positional or speed mode; and upon operation, the driver controls the servo motor to operate, such that operational output values of each of the encoders at each operation time or when each operation period goes by change according to the stored learning output values regularly.
source_title: MANUALLY TAUGHT ROBOT AND METHOD FOR MANUALLY TEACHING ROBOT

abstract: The invention discloses a dual-arm beverage robot and a multi-point-location radiation type motion planning method thereof. The left side and the right side of a body of the robot are each provided with a series mechanical arm above four freedom degrees, the waist joint of the robot can be rotated in a positioned manner, the robot avoids collision between the mechanical arm and periphery equipmentlike a material cabinet through the multi-point-location radiation type motion planning method, and collision in the dual arm motion process, the motion path between point positions can be optimized,and through the method, the motion path between two points can be rapidly calculated.
source_title: Dual-arm beverage robot and multi-point-location radiation type motion planning method thereof

abstract: The invention relates to a laser tracker based combined operating test method for a dual-arm robot. The dual-arm robot comprises an operator A and an operator B, wherein a laser tracker is used to separately measure pose parameters of the operator A and post parameters of the operator B while the operator A and the operator B separately control a workpiece 1 and a workpiece 2 to work; and dual-armcombined pose accuracy and repeatability, dual-arm combined track accuracy and speed accuracy are obtained by calculating a deviation value and weighted average of pose parameters of the operator A and the operator B, so that accomplishing degree, on workpiece assembly combined operation, of the dual-arm robot is described. The laser tracker based combined operating test method solves the problemabout test precision of related matched data in current dual-arm robot combined operation, and the like very well.
source_title: Laser tracker based combined operating test method for dual-arm robot

abstract: The invention discloses a two-arm robot control method and system based on three-dimensional machine vision, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a segmentation point cloud: projecting a Gray code to an initial object, collecting and obtaining an initial projection image, and obtaining the three-dimensional data and target point cloud of the initial object; target pose acquisition: acquiring an input point cloud and an operation position of a to-be-operated object to be operated by the double-arm robot, and performing point cloud matching in combination with the target point cloud to obtain a target pose; grabbing control is conducted, specifically, one mechanical arm of the double-arm robot is controlled to conduct grabbing according to the target pose; tracking and shooting: continuously projecting Gray codes to the objects grabbed by the double-arm robot and acquiring a plurality of object grabbing projection images; acquiring an updated target pose: performing three-dimensional reconstruction on the acquired object capturing projection image, calculating the pose after the operation position is shifted, and acquiring the updated target pose; and operation control: controlling the other mechanical arm to operate according to the updated target pose.
source_title: Two-arm robot control method and system based on three-dimensional machine vision

abstract: The invention discloses a double-arm space robot inverse kinematics solving method integrating trunk height and attitude constraint, and relates to the technical field of space robots. The method sequentially comprises the steps that a geometry-based kinematics model of the double-arm space robot is established, a trunk virtual position formula is established, a trunk virtual pose is calculated according to trunk height and pose constraints, a mobile end expected pose is converted into expected poses under all single arms, and a single-branch-arm inverse kinematics solver is called to calculate joint angles and integrate the joint angles. A trunk height and attitude constraint problem is converted into an unconstrained two-single-arm inverse kinematics problem, the problem solving dimension is reduced, a parallel computing strategy can be adopted, when the double-arm space robot executes a task, the trunk attitude is adjusted while the trunk and a space mechanism keep a safe height, disturbance of the robot and the space mechanism is reduced, and the task execution efficiency is improved. And task field image information can be obtained more flexibly through the trunk camera.
source_title: Double-arm space robot inverse kinematics solving method integrating trunk height and attitude constraint

abstract: PURPOSE: A system for simultaneously driving both arms of a serving robot is provided so that the both arms of robot are moved to the same angle as the same direction. Object and the carried food maintain the same angle as the surface. It prevents from object and food falling. CONSTITUTION: A simultaneous driving is system both arms of the robot for serving comprises a joint unit, a driving part, connection part, grippers(206a, 206b). Wrist is located in the left of the robot for serving, and the right side. Wrist constitutes both arms. The driving part runs the wrist of robot. It is connected to wrist and the connection part at the same time runs wrist, and gripper the object. Wrist at the same time moves to the same direction as the same angle.
source_title: The serving robot system that simultaneously driving both his arms

abstract: The invention discloses a double-arm robot coffee making device, and relates to the technical field of automatic coffee makers, the double-arm robot coffee making device comprises a workbench, a first mechanical arm and a second mechanical arm, the first mechanical arm and the second mechanical arm are inversely installed on a top plate, the workbench is further provided with a coffee machine, and the first mechanical arm and the second mechanical arm are arranged on the top plate. An adjusting mechanism is arranged at the end, close to the first clamping jaw, of the first mechanical arm, an anti-disengaging mechanism is connected to the bottom of the adjusting mechanism, and the first mechanical arm and the second mechanical arm are inversely installed on the top plate, so that on one hand, the occupied space of an operation area can be reduced, and on the other hand, the posture and state closer to manual operation can be achieved; and compared with single-arm making, the coffee making machine has the advantages that the working efficiency of coffee making is improved, and the waiting time of customers is shortened.
source_title: Coffee making device with double-arm robot

abstract: The invention relates to a double-arm intelligent collaborative tea picking method and device based on multi-strategy dynamic scheduling, and belongs to the field of robot automation. The method comprises the following steps: obtaining three-dimensional coordinate information of a target picking point; identifying and positioning potential branch and leaf shields, and generating space data of the shields; the method comprises the following steps: simultaneously projecting a shielding object and a clamping jaw geometric contour under an expected grabbing pose on a plane where a target picking point is located, analyzing the overlapping amount, the proximity and/or the density of the projections of the shielding object and the clamping jaw geometric contour, and generating a standardized shielding evaluation index; comparing the shielding evaluation index with a preset decision threshold, and if the shielding evaluation index is greater than the preset decision threshold, executing a master-slave collaborative picking method based on multi-stage positioning; otherwise, executing the parallel picking method based on dynamic collision-free region division. The problems that a traditional single-arm tea picking robot is low in operation efficiency, high in collision risk and insufficient in intelligent degree in a dense and unstructured tea tree environment are solved.
source_title: Double-arm intelligent collaborative tea picking method and device based on multi-strategy dynamic scheduling

abstract: The invention discloses a power-assisted robot. The power-assisted robot comprises a back skeleton; two motors, speed reducers, a controller and a storage battery supplying power for the two motors through the controller are arranged on the rear side of the back skeleton; output shafts of the two speed reducers are each provided with a wire wheel; two pulley transmission devices are each fixedly connected with one end of the bottom of the back skeleton; two auxiliary arms are each hinged to the corresponding pulley transmission device; and the auxiliary arms and the pulley transmission devicesare provided with resetting devices. Compared with the prior art, the power-assisted robot has the beneficial effects that the structure is reasonable, due to the structure of the power-assisted robot, force being about to be borne by the two hands can be completely or mostly transferred to the back portion to be borne, the bearing force of the two arms can be greatly reduced, and therefore heavier articles can be lifted up or held up. The two auxiliary arms can be correspondingly adjusted to be in different lifting heights and are applicable to weights in different bottom shapes. The power-assisted robot can be widely applied to medical treatment, construction, express delivery, carrying and other industries, and the labor efficiency of people is greatly improved.
source_title: Power-assisted robot

abstract: The invention provides a body rotation telescopic household service robot capable of effectively saving space. The body rotation telescopic household service robot comprises a head, shoulders, arms, mechanical hands, a body, a chassis assembly and a controller. The body is connected to the chassis assembly through a first telescopic mechanism. The shoulders are fixed to the upper portion of the body. The two arms are connected to the two sides of the shoulders. The two mechanical hands are connected to the ends of the two arms. The head is connected to the shoulders. Each arm comprises a second telescopic mechanism. The chassis assembly comprises a bottom plate, a traveling mechanism and a rotating mechanism. The bottom plate is connected with the first telescopic mechanism through the rotating mechanism. The traveling mechanism is connected to the lower portion of the bottom plate and comprises a universal wheel and two hub motors. The shoulders, the arms, the hub motors, the rotatingmechanism, the first telescopic mechanism, the second telescopic mechanisms and the mechanical hands are connected with the controller. The body rotation telescopic household service robot capable ofeffectively saving space saves space, adapts to a family operation environment, and is simple, convenient, easy to use, safe and reliable.
source_title: Body rotation telescopic household service robot capable of effectively saving space

abstract: The present invention performs dual arm robot teaching work intuitively and easily. This dual arm robot teaching system (1) is provided with: a dual arm robot (2) equipped with two arms (4R, 4L) obtained by connecting multiple links using joint shafts, and two indicator units (5R, 5L) that are provided on the respective tips of the two arms, indicate spatial coordinate points, and are configured so as to allow gripping by a teacher; and a control device (3) for acquiring the coordinate points, indicated as a result of the teacher moving the two indicator units directly and simultaneously with both hands, as teaching points and teaching the action corresponding to the acquired teaching points to the dual arm robot.
source_title: DUAL ARM ROBOT TEACHING SYSTEM AND DUAL ARM ROBOT TEACHING METHOD

abstract: The invention discloses a double-arm hand-simulated full-automatic magic cube restoring robot. The robot comprises a rack, an executing mechanism and an electrical control part, wherein the executing mechanism comprises a left mechanical arm and a right mechanical arm, the axes of the left mechanical arm and the right mechanical arm are perpendicular to each other, the left mechanical arm and the right mechanical arm are fixed to the rack and clamp two pairs of parallel faces of a magic cube cube correspondingly, the electrical control part comprises an image acquisition assembly and an electrical control assembly, the image acquisition assembly comprises a plurality of image acquisition modules opposite to the magic cube, the image acquisition modules are fixed to the rack and distributed around the magic cube, the signal output end of each image acquisition module is connected with the input end of the electrical control assembly, and the output end of the electrical control assembly is connected with the left mechanical arm and the right mechanical arm. According to the robot, the electrical control assembly judges the state of the magic cube according to information collected by the image collection assembly, and the magic cube is clamped and twisted through the execution mechanism, so that the magic cube is rapidly restored; and the magic cube teaching training efficiency is greatly improved, and favorable conditions are created for improving the teaching level of the magic cube.
source_title: Double-arm human-hand-simulated full-automatic magic cube restoring robot

abstract: The invention discloses a two-arm robot flexible assembly method, device and equipment and a medium, and relates to the technical field of robot assembly.The method comprises the steps that gravity compensation is conducted on a contact force signal of a two-arm robot, and the compensated contact force signal is obtained; dynamically adjusting an impedance control model by using a fuzzy controller based on the compensated contact force signal to obtain a parameter-adjusted impedance control model; and according to the parameter-adjusted impedance control model and the compensated contact force signal, motion planning is conducted on the double-arm robot, and a flexible assembly result of the double-arm robot is obtained. The self motion state can be adjusted in real time according to changes of the external environment, it is ensured that the contact force in the assembling process is always kept within a proper range, and therefore the assembling precision is remarkably improved; the self-adaptive impedance control strategy can effectively avoid the situation that elements are damaged due to excessive force, and the production cost is reduced.
source_title: Flexible assembly method, device and equipment for double-arm robot and medium

abstract: The present invention relates to a rescue robot in which a track is connected to a manipulator on both arms. The rescue robot includes: left and right moving platforms (20A, 20B) in which the end of an upper leg track (30-1) and a start end of a lower leg track (40-1) to rotate so that the shape can be freely changed from a standing mode vertical to the ground and to a crawler mode horizontal to the ground; and the both arm manipulators (50A, 50B) with an arm track (90) performing a role of an auxiliary roller by moving on the ground without a driving power while coming into contact with the ground or lifting up or down an injured person. Therefore, the rescue robot remarkably improves mobility in a limit rugged place and flexibility in the rugged place. The rescue robot can safely transfer a life and enables dynamic balancing control while lifting up the injured person (1) by the both arm manipulators (50A, 50B).
source_title: TRACK TYPE ARMS MANIPULATOR FOR LIFE SAVING ROBOT

abstract: The invention provides a control method of a double-arm robot, the double-arm robot and electronic equipment. The method comprises the steps that current joint angles of multiple joints of the double-arm robot are obtained; determining a target function based on double-arm differential kinematics according to the current joint angle; the joint limitation of the multiple joints is used as a constraint condition, an optimal solution of the target function is solved, and target joint speeds of the multiple joints are obtained; obtaining a target joint angle according to the target joint speed; updating the current joint angle according to the target joint angle, and iteratively executing the steps of determining a target function based on double-arm differential kinematics according to the current joint angle, solving an optimal solution of the target function and obtaining the target joint angle according to the target joint speed. The target joint angle meets the closed chain constraint of the double-arm cooperation task of the double-arm robot; and controlling the double-arm robot to move according to the target joint angle. According to the technical scheme, the joint angle meeting closed chain constraint and joint limiting can be obtained.
source_title: Control method of double-arm robot, double-arm robot and electronic equipment

abstract: The invention relates to a two-arm robot grabbing pose selection method and system and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps that a fitness value range, an iteration number threshold value and a fitness function are set; calculating population gene fitness, judging whether the population is in a value range or not, if so, ending iteration, otherwise, continuing to judge whether the number of iterations reaches an iteration number threshold value or not, if so, ending iteration, otherwise, carrying out crossover and mutation operation, and dynamically selecting a gene retention strategy according to the iteration depth and the fitness size; the gene is reserved; updating the gene population representing the grabbing position, and returning to carry out judgment circulation; and obtaining an optimal target corresponding to the two arms after iteration is finished. According to the method, the grabbing symmetry of the two arms, the maximum rotation angle of the joints of the two arms and the difference of the rotation angles of the maximum joints of the two arms are comprehensively considered, the calculation of the fitness function is dynamically adjusted, the algorithm is guided to converge in the global optimal direction, and finally a multi-target comprehensive optimal result can be obtained.
source_title: Two-arm robot grabbing pose selection method and system and storage medium

abstract: The invention provides a similarity-in-form and similarity-in-spirit combined person simulating double-arm robot motion planning control method. The human motion action is converted into person simulating double-arm robot motion planning based on similarity-in-form control, and the tail end smoothness character of each mechanical arm during person simulating double-arm robot operation is similar to the person based on similarity-in-spirit control. By means of the method, the motion experience when the human carries out the task operation in the unstructured environment can be effectively usedfor reference, robot rapid planning in the unstructured environment is achieved through similarity-in-form control, the human arm motion and rigidity changing rule can be used for reference, tail endsmoothness control parameters are corrected online based on the person motion intention, accordingly, the mechanical arms show the smoothness character similar to the person when making contact with the environment or operation target, and accordingly the person simulating double-arm safety and protection robot operation task executing effect in the unstructured environment is improved.
source_title: Similarity-in-form and similarity-in-spirit combined person simulating double-arm robot motion planning control method

abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent double-arm robot comprising a control box body, convenient moving modules, a supporting column body, a robot main body, multi-axis mechanical arms, multifunctional mechanical hands, a visual movement supporting component, a robot head, robot visual systems and mechanical hand visual systems. The convenient moving modules are carried on the robot so that the robot can move conveniently and can be more flexible; and meanwhile, the robot vision systems, the mechanical hand vision systems and an intelligent voice system are arranged, and convenient man-machine interaction can be achieved through the vision recognition and voice recognition functions. By means of arranged sensor anti-collision systems, man-machine coexistence safety can be ensured, and by means of the arranged multi-axis mechanical arms and the multifunctional mechanical hands, multi-scene application can be achieved.
source_title: Intelligent double-arm robot

abstract: The invention discloses a dual-arm robot teleoperation control system shared by two persons. By establishing a double-hand sharing operating module, operation mapping between both hands of two main hands and a robot is achieved; and then a main manipulator and an auxiliary manipulator are divided, and a main operating arm and an auxiliary operating arm are distinguished in the operating process of the main manipulator, so that operation assisting of the main manipulator is achieved. Meanwhile, the situations such as collision and misoperation of the auxiliary operating arm in the operating process of the main manipulator can be avoided, and thus barrier avoidance and double-hand fine teleoperation are achieved.
source_title: Dual-arm robot teleoperation control system shared by two persons

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and particularly relates to a robot, a double-arm tight coupling cooperation method and device thereof and a computer application program. The method comprises the steps of obtaining task data of a robot double-arm tight coupling cooperation task, inputting the task data into an imitation learning model, and generating a motion path of a main mechanical arm, wherein the imitation learning model is generated by training a training data set obtained by randomly adding obstacles according to a preset rule in a preset environment through a supervised learning model, and the task data comprises mechanical arm state data, obstacle information data and target information data; a main mechanical arm of the robot is controlled to move along the movement path; and a slave mechanical arm of the robot is controlled to synchronously move along with the master mechanical arm. According to the invention, based on geometric approximation and an illusion mechanism, obstacles are randomly added to enhance a training data set of imitation learning, so that a robot two-arm tight coupling cooperation task is realized based on an imitation learning model.
source_title: Robot, double-arm tight coupling cooperation method and device thereof and computer application program

abstract: The invention discloses a wall-climbing robot for operation of a boiler water-cooled wall of a thermal power plant. The wall-climbing robot comprises a double-arm suspension system, an obstacle-crossing adsorption system, a self-adaptive steering system, a cleaning system and a steering angle measurement and analysis technology.
