The double-arm suspension system comprises a main beam, a frame-shaped frame, a steering gear, a fixer, suspension double cross arms, a vibration damper and a hub motor; the obstacle crossing adsorption system comprises a parallelogram obstacle crossing rocker arm, a magnetic steel box, an array permanent magnet and a reset device; the self-adaptive steering system comprises a ball head piece, a trapezoidal bevel edge piece and a self-adaptive trapezoidal short connecting rod; the cleaning system comprises a disc type counter-rotating brush, a transmission system and a blunt triangular ash residue separation mechanism; and the steering angle measurement analysis technology comprises a magneto-sensitive element, a deep neural network model and a data fusion filter. Based on the design, the water-cooled wall climbing robot can remarkably improve the wall surface adsorption stability, the complex wall surface adaptability and the movement and obstacle crossing ability, and can implement efficient water-cooled wall walking operation.
source_title: Wall-climbing robot for walking operation of boiler water-cooled wall of thermal power plant

abstract: The invention relates to a method (10) of manipulating a construction object (101) on a construction site, for example positioning, moving, or working the construction object, using a construction robot system (100), wherein the construction robot system (100) comprises at least two robotic arms (110). According to the invention a controller virtually manipulates a virtual representation of the construction object (101'), and a control unit (104) of the construction robot system (100) controls the robotic arms (110) such that the construction object (101) is manipulated according to the virtual manipulation of the virtual representation of the construction object (101'). Furthermore, the invention relates to a construction robot system (100) and a computer program product (108). The invention provides an intuitive and safe way of manipulating the construction object (101).
source_title: METHOD OF MANIPULATING A CONSTRUCTION OBJECT, CONSTRUCTION ROBOT SYSTEM, AND COMPUTER PROGRAM PRODUCT

abstract: The invention relates to a deep reinforcement learning dual-arm robot control method based on demonstration examples, and a system. The deep reinforcement learning dual-arm robot control method based on the demonstration examples comprises the steps of obtaining the three-dimensional coordinate motion increment of the position of a clamping jaw at the tail end of each group of mechanical arm based on the shortest distance between an initial coordinate of the clamping jaw at the tail end of a dual-arm robot and an initial coordinate of a target object, and forming a first demonstration example used for demonstration; after the clamping jaw closes to grab the object, obtaining the three-dimensional coordinate motion increment of the position of the clamping jaw at the tail end of each group of mechanical arm based on the shortest distance between the initial coordinate of the target object and a final coordinate of the target object, and forming a second demonstration example used for demonstration; and utilizing the demonstration examples of the two parts to form a complete expert demonstration track, adopting an experience playback pool of a double-agent deep deterministic policy gradient algorithm to randomly extract a small batch of samples to form training data, training a neural network, and achieving control over the dual-arm robot. The reinforcement learning algorithm reinforces the action sequence of the demonstration examples, and fast learning is carried out until the task is completed.
source_title: Deep reinforcement learning dual-arm robot control method based on demonstration examples, and system

abstract:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a double-arm type robot manipulator enabling the approach from an upper part and a front part without changing a manipulator installed position.

SOLUTION: This double-arm type robot manipulator is composed of a barrel 1 arranged on a revolving shaft J8, a right arm 2R and a left arm 2L provided on the barrel 1, and a plurality of revolute joint shafts J1-J7 constituting the right arm 2R and the left arm 2L. The first revolute joint shaft J1 for the right arm 2R and the left arm 2L is arranged in front of the barrel 1.

source_title: DOUBLE-ARM TYPE ROBOT MANIPULATOR

abstract: The invention relates to a double-arm writing robot, in particular to a double-arm writing robot and a writing method thereof, and the double-arm writing robot comprises a base, a curved joint mechanical arm group, a controller and a page turning device. The curved joint mechanical arm group comprises two mechanical arms; the page turning device is arranged on the base; the base is provided with two rows of guide grooves, and a writing area is arranged between the two rows of guide grooves. The page turning device comprises two page turning units; the page turning unit comprises a supporting frame and a static electricity generating part so as to adsorb paper to be turned. The supporting frame is provided with an upper support and a lower support, and the lower end of the upper support is connected with the lower support through a hinge and used for driving the hinge to swing. According to the double-arm writing robot, indentations are not prone to being left on paper due to suction force or clamping force due to local stress concentration, and after pages are turned through the hinge joint of the upper support and the lower support, the two static electricity generating parts are directly used for pressing the paper on the two sides at the center seam position of a book.
source_title: Double-arm writing robot and writing method thereof

abstract: The invention relates to a visual servo coordination control method and device for a double-arm space robot, and the method comprises the steps: building a plurality of constraint relationships of the double-arm space robot, and constructing a macroscopic motion decision model of the double-arm space robot according to the plurality of constraint relationships and a preset reinforcement learning algorithm; based on a preset two-arm cooperation task scene, training an evaluation network and a strategy network in the macroscopic motion decision model, and generating an evaluation network and a strategy network of the two-arm space robot meeting preset training conditions; and based on a preset mathematical simulation environment, the optimization evaluation network and the strategy network, a final macroscopic motion decision model is obtained to generate an optimal joint reference trajectory of the double-arm space robot, and the double-arm space robot is controlled to perform coordinated motion according to the joint reference trajectory. Therefore, the problems that a double-arm space robot cannot adapt to various unstructured environments, the requirement for future space on-orbit service fine operation is difficult to meet, and autonomy and intelligence are poor are solved.
source_title: Visual servo coordination control method and device for double-arm space robot

abstract: This horizontal multi-articulated robot is provided with: a first connection part (31) that is disposed between two arms and is configured to rotatably connect one of the arms to the other arm; a second connection part (32) that is disposed between a base (20) and one of the arms and configured to rotatably connect the arms to the base (20); and a ring member that is disposed between the first connection part (31) and the arm and formed so that the height of the ring member is set higher on one end side in the extending direction of the arms than on the other end side.
source_title: HORIZONTAL MULTI-ARTICULATED ROBOT

abstract: The invention discloses a double-arm robot safety cooperative control method based on fixed time convergence, and belongs to the field of double-arm robot control. Firstly, a double-arm robot and a load kinematics model and a dynamical model of the double-arm robot are established, then a position controller is designed according to the dynamical model based on a sliding mode control algorithm of fixed time convergence, and the control torque of each joint of a mechanical arm is obtained; internal force in the clamping direction of the tail ends of the left arm and the right arm of the double-arm robot is calculated through a dynamic model and load stress analysis; an internal force controller is designed to convert an internal force error into a control output force, and the control output force is converted into a force control torque of each joint, so that the safety control of the double-arm robot is realized; and finally, the force and the position control torque are superposed and input into the dynamic model, so that the double-arm robot realizes synchronous control of the pose and the clamping force. According to the method, it can be guaranteed that the two-arm robot can rapidly track the expected pose, synchronous control over the clamping force of the two-arm robot can be achieved, and finally the two-arm collaborative carrying task is completed.
source_title: Double-arm robot safety cooperative control method based on fixed time convergence

abstract: The invention discloses a rehabilitation robot treatment instrument for cerebral thrombosis sequela treatment. The treatment instrument comprises a robot arranged on a bed device 2, a patient 5 can lie down on the body of the robot 1, arc-shaped groove devices 3 are arranged on the surfaces of the two arms, the two legs, the trunk and the head of the robot, fixing devices 6 are arranged on the periphery of the arc-shaped groove devices 3 on the arms, the legs and the trunk of the robot, glove devices 9 are fixed to the hands of the robot 1, foot cover devices 17 are arranged on the feet of the robot, and a music device 15 is arranged on the robot. The rehabilitation robot for cerebral thrombosis sequela treatment solves the problems that limb rehabilitation exercises of cerebral thrombosis patients are reduced and patients suffering from hemiplegia sequelae have pressure sores and muscle spasm, achieves the aims of making fingers, arms, waists, legs and feet of cerebral thrombosis patients move and replacing manual massage, and makes the limbs of the patients exercised and rehabilitated.
source_title: Rehabilitation robot treatment instrument and treatment method for cerebral thrombosis sequela treatment

abstract: The invention provides a double-arm dexterous operation robot system which comprises a mounting frame, a robot body and a control system. The double-arm robot is arranged in the containing space and comprises a robot body, a five-finger grabbing arm and a grabbing and sucking integrated grabbing arm, and the five-finger grabbing arm and the grabbing and sucking integrated grabbing arm are arranged on the two sides of the robot body. The sensing device comprises a pose sensor and a force sensor which are arranged on the double-arm robot and a visual sensor arranged on the mounting frame, the pose sensor is used for collecting pose information of the double-arm robot, the force sensor is used for collecting torque change information of the double-arm robot, and the visual sensor is used for collecting torque change information of the double-arm robot. The visual sensor is used for collecting visual data information of an object to be operated; and the supporting device is used for conveying the objects to be operated. The invention provides a double-arm dexterous operation robot system which aims at solving the problem that a double-arm robot in the prior art is single in grabbing and operation capacity.
source_title: Double-arm dexterous operation robot system

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of intelligent processing, and particularly discloses a double-arm teaching assembly method and system based on dynamic motion primitives. An operator drags the two mechanical arms at the same time to conduct asymmetric assembly task teaching demonstration, and robot tail end pose track data in the teaching process are collected; performing two-arm assembly skill learning on the robot tail end pose trajectory data by adopting a reversible dynamic motion primitive; on the basis of the learned double-arm assembly skill, an absolute expected pose track and a relative expected pose track of a main arm are generated in real time, and then an expected pose track of a slave arm is obtained; and carrying out compliance adjustment on the expected pose tracks of the master arm and the slave arm so as to obtain an action instruction of the robot. According to the teaching assembly algorithm based on the reversible dynamic motion primitive, rapid deployment of the double-arm assembly task is achieved, complex expert programming is avoided, the robot deployment threshold and cost are reduced, and the assembly precision is improved.
source_title: Double-arm teaching assembly method and system based on dynamic motion primitive

abstract: The invention provides an indoor path planning method for a double-arm transfer nursing robot, and the method comprises the following steps: constructing an obstacle map, determining search nodes according to a current point and an end point, and calculating the total cost of each search node, the total cost being the sum of the cost away from a starting point, the cost away from the end point, and the safety cost; taking the search node with the minimum total cost as a known node and storing the known node into a second list, and storing the rest search nodes except the known node into the first list; selecting a search node with the minimum total cost from the first list as a current point; connecting all known nodes in the second list according to indexes to obtain an initial global path, and deleting redundant known nodes to obtain an optimized global path; and based on each important node in the optimized global path, a local path is planned by adopting an improved dynamic window algorithm, the local path is planned by using the optimized global path, and the two-arm transfer nursing robot is guided to find a path, so that the nursed person can be carried more quickly and more safely.
source_title: Indoor path planning method for double-arm transfer nursing robot

abstract: A double-arm collaborative robot comprises a base, stand columns which are arranged on the base in the vertical direction, a pair of vertical adjusting mechanisms which are respectively arranged on the stand columns, and a pair of mechanical arms which are assembled to the vertical adjusting mechanisms respectively. The vertical adjusting mechanisms are used for adjusting the height positions of the corresponding mechanical arms, and each mechanical arm is provided with at least two movable joints with rotating shafts parallel in the axial direction. The double-arm collaborative robot has the advantages of being simple in single-arm structure, small in self weight and high in load capacity, and a low-cost solution is easy to achieve.
source_title: Double-arm collaborative robot

abstract: A teleoperation control method of a hydraulic quadruped two-arm robot comprises the following steps of (1) establishing a pose description of a five-degree-of-freedom mechanical arm in a base coordinate system; (2) establishing a kinematic model of the five-degree-of-freedom mechanical arm; (3) designing a single-arm control method according to the kinematic model in the step (2); (4) designing a five-degree-of-freedom hydraulic mechanical arm control system; (5) designing a two-arm teleoperation mode; (6) establishing a three-degree-of-freedom single-leg kinematic model of the quadruped robot; (7) establishing a virtual model control method of the quadruped robot; and (8) conducting teleoperation on the hydraulic quadruped two-arm robot. A single operator operates a remote controller to control the quadruped two-arm robot, the remote controller transmits an expected instruction to a computer of the robot, then the computer obtains the expected control quantity of each joint through control laws and model calculation, and the motion control of the hydraulic quadruped robot is achieved. According to the method, the independent operation task of the single arm can be achieved, and the collaborative operation of two arms can also be achieved.
source_title: Teleoperation control method of hydraulic quadruped two-arm robot

abstract: The invention discloses a dual-arm robot. The dual-arm robot comprises a base plate and an outer casing arranged on the base plate, wherein a left mechanical arm is arranged on the left side of the outer casing; a right mechanical arm is arranged on the right side of the outer casing; the left mechanical arm comprises a first driving motor, a first rotating plate, a second driving motor, a first swing plate, a third driving motor, a second swing plate, a fourth driving motor, a second rotating plate, a fifth driving motor, a third swing plate, a sixth driving motor and a manipulator; the right mechanical arm and the left mechanical arm form a bilateral symmetry structure. The dual-arm robot disclosed by the invention takes a digital rudder controller as a power source, can easily finish the contents of teaching demonstration, scientific activities and the like, and has the advantages of higher response speed, smaller integral volume and higher stability.
source_title: Dual-arm robot

abstract: The invention discloses a robot double-arm collaborative operation control method based on internal force detection. The method comprises the steps that the mapping relation between force and torque ho acting on the center of a clamped object and force and torque h applied to the clamped object by the tail end of a mechanical arm is constructed; according to the force and torque actually acting on the clamped object by the mechanical arm and the expected motion state of the clamped object, the internal force delta ho at the mass center is obtained through the mapping relation; according to the internal force delta ho at the mass center, the internal force deviation delta hIi of the tail end of the mechanical arm is obtained through the mapping relation; according to the internal force deviation delta hIi of the tail end of the mechanical arm, the position correction amount of the tail end of the mechanical arm is obtained, and compliant control over cooperative operation of the two arms of the robot is achieved through position control; by using the mechanical arm, the internal force between the mechanical arm and a clamped object can be analyzed and controlled, and the flexibility of contact between the mechanical arm and the environment is improved.
source_title: Robot double-arm collaborative operation control method based on internal force detection

abstract: The invention discloses a self-collision prevention trajectory planning method for a seven-degree-of-freedom double-arm collaborative robot, and belongs to the field of robot control. The self-collision prevention trajectory planning method for the seven-degree-of-freedom double-arm collaborative robot comprises the steps of adopting a master-slave control method, firstly performing S-shaped trajectory planning on a master arm, deriving a motion trajectory of a slave arm according to a coordinated motion constraint relationship between two arms, performing collision detection on the master arm and the slave arm by using a collision detection method, and if a track does not have an overlapped part, completing motion planning; and if the overlapped part exists, regarding the mater mechanical arm as an obstacle, and conducting trajectory planning on the slave mechanical arm again till the motion trajectories of the two arms are not overlapped. According to the self-collision prevention trajectory planning method for the seven-degree-of-freedom double-arm collaborative robot provided by the invention, under the condition that a sensor is not used, whether the two arms collide or not is detected only through calculation and analysis, trajectory planning of seven-degree-of-freedom double-arm cooperation is achieved, the method is simple, and the calculation speed is high.
source_title: Self-collision prevention trajectory planning method and system for seven-degree-of-freedom double-arm collaborative robot

abstract: The invention relates to a double-arm magic cube robot which comprises a base plate, a frame, two manipulators and an image acquisition system. Each manipulator comprises a manipulator support, a rotating motor and a mechanical claw, wherein the rotating motor is arranged on the base plate through the manipulator support, and the rotating motor is connected with a long screw rod, the long screw rod is connected with the manipulator support through a rotary joint, the other end of the long screw rod extends upwards and is connected with a limiting plate, the mechanical claw is arranged on the limiting plate, the mechanical claw comprises a pair of claws and a driving mechanism used for driving the pair of claws to act, and supporting parts and U-shaped slot holes are arranged on the claws.Through a plurality of cameras, information acquisition is more accurate, and identification speed is faster; due to the fact that the corresponding supporting parts are arranged on the claws, a magiccube can be placed more accurately and conveniently, and meanwhile, the U-shaped slot holes are formed in the claws, so that inaccurate information acquisition caused by the fact that the claws blockthe magic cube is avoided; and each manipulator is provided with one pair of claws, the magic cube is more flexible to turn over, and the turning speed is higher.
source_title: Double-arm magic cube robot

abstract: PURPOSE:To enlarge the work range of a double-arm robot. CONSTITUTION:A double-arm robot is provided with plural manipulators 12A, 12B, and these manipulators 12A, 12B are supported in the independently movable state. The work range of the manipulators 12A, 12B are thereby enlarged in the moving direction. A parts feeding area is provided at the rear part in the moving direction, and a parts assembling area is provided at the front part in the moving direction, so that the carry-in of parts into parts assembling area can be also performed by the robot to obtain the variety of work contents.
source_title: Multi-manipulator robot apparatus

abstract: The present invention relates to a dual arm robot comprising a body (1), a first arm (2) attached to the body in a first attachment point (3), a second arm (5) attached to the body in a second attachment point (6), and a controller (10) adapted to control the motions of the arms based on desired positions of the arms. The controller comprises a position correction module (12) for correcting the position of the second arm due to the position and movements of the first arm, and the position correction module is adapted to determine an elastic deformation in the second attachment point based on the force acting on the first attachment point and an elastic model of the body, to determine the change of the position of the second arm based on the determined elastic deformation in the second attachment point, and to correct the position of the second arm based on the determined change of the position of the second arm.
source_title: A dual arm robot and a method for controlling a dual arm robot

abstract: The invention relates to a line patrol robot capable of climbing poles and towers. A structure of a double-arm line patrol robot is adopted, and two mechanical arms are arranged on the same side of the robot. Each mechanical arm has three degrees of freedom and is capable of moving up and down along the arm length direction, rotating in the direction of a vertical plane of the mechanical arms, rotating along a horizontal plane of a robot body and integrally moving along a rail on the robot body; the upper portion of each mechanical arm is provided with two half rollers capable of opening and closing along the corresponding mechanical arm. The line patrol robot is capable of climbing poles and towers to inspect faults of the poles and the towers and capable of conveniently getting on and off lines to complete power transmission line inspection tasks. Further, obstacle crossing ways of the robot on power transmission lines are simple, posture control of the robot is easy, and accordingly patrol efficiency can be improved, and autonomous intelligence of the robot can be improved.
source_title: Line patrol robot capable of climbing poles and towers and climbing method

abstract: The invention provides a multifunctional detection and maintenance double-arm actuator for a remote operation platform, which belongs to the field of specialized robots and comprises a mounting base, a crane device, a mechanical arm, a rocker arm, a visual lighting device and the like. The crane device is arranged in the middle of the front end of the mounting base and can assist the mechanical arm in bearing a workpiece. The two mechanical arms are symmetrically hung at the front end of the mounting base and located on the left side and the right side of the crane device correspondingly, and different tools can be carried to accurately adjust the posture to complete operation. The two rocker arms are arranged at the front end of the mounting base and located at the upper position and the lower position of the crane device correspondingly, carry a visual lighting device, support posture transformation, and can scan, recognize and extract a target and guide the mechanical arm to conduct detection and maintenance work. The mounting base can provide mounting positions and bear weight for all the components and accessories thereof. By means of the unique layout form, the device can be carried by a heavy load arm in a CMOR system in a folded state to enter a complex and narrow divertor space for detection and maintenance operation.
source_title: Multifunctional detection and maintenance double-arm actuator for remote operation platform

abstract: The invention relates to the field of intelligent robots, and provides a double-arm control method and system for a nursing robot, and the method comprises the steps: collecting the moving tracks of double arms of the nursing robot, and defining a driving arm and a driven arm for the double arms of the nursing robot; when the driving arm moves along the moving track, dynamic control is triggered for the driving arm and the corresponding multiple joint parts, and dynamic control over the driving arm is carried out based on a fuzzy PID control algorithm; position and force control is fused for a driving arm and a driven arm, coordination of the driving arm and the driven arm is enhanced, and operation of the driving arm and the driven arm in different environments is controlled for a fuzzy PID control algorithm. Defining a nursing path of the driven arm and the driving arm according to the contact parameters of the driven arm and the driving arm to the patient, the contact space position and the moving track; a mechanical system of the driven arm and the driving arm in the nursing path is defined, and the nursing control logic of the driven arm and the driving arm to the patient is controlled.
source_title: Double-arm control method and system of nursing robot

abstract: A rigid link for a flexible robot, the rigid link comprising a rigid link body having a hollow core, the rigid link being provided with at least two arms having proximal and distal ends, the arms are connected to the rigid link body, and wherein the arms being deployable between a closed configuration in which the proximal and distal ends of the arms are positioned proximate to the rigid link body and open configuration in which the arms are moved so that the distal ends of the arms are positioned away from the body of the rigid link.
source_title: CONTINUUM ROBOT STIFFENING

abstract: At present, the intelligence level of robots developed in China is not high in simulation of human activities, and the situation is only restricted to double-arm robots which adopt base chassis rollers as the lower limbs. The intelligent robot has the motion function as flexible as that of human beings and also has the capability of automatically adapting to environmental changes, and correspondingly the safety of the intelligent robot and the environment in which the intelligent robot is located is ensured; the intelligent robot also has the capability of automatically forming task steps andautomatically and independently completing tasks according to instructions input by a user and consists of a framework system and a function system, the shape of the intelligent robot is kept and maintained by the framework system, and meanwhile the framework system is also an actuating mechanism for completing the work tasks and consists of bones, joints, nerves, muscles, fascia, ligaments, skinand the like; the function system achieves the functions of the role played by the intelligent robot according to the rules and criteria of the environment in which the human beings are positioned, and helps the human beings to finish designated work. The function system comprises a control system, a driving system, a sensing system, a navigation positioning system, a path planning system, a tasksystem and a skill system, an information base, a human-computer interaction system and the like.
source_title: Intelligent robot

abstract: The invention discloses a method for measuring an arm length of an SCARA robot. The method comprises the following steps that 1, two arms of the SCARA robot are enabled to be as straight as possible in an XY plane along an X axis or a Y axis, and an initial position (x0, y0) is obtained; 2, an arm 2 is clockwise rotated by alpha to obtain a position 1 (x1, y1); 3, the arm 2 is anticlockwise rotated by 2*alpha to obtain a position 2 (x2, y2); 4, a value described in specification and a length L2 of the arm 2 can be obtained through a method for solving a radius of a circle by means of three points in a plane; 5, the arm returns to the initial position (x0, y0), namely, an angle between the arm and a horizontal coordinate is a value described in the specification; 6, the arm 1 is clockwise rotated by alpha, and the arm 2 is anticlockwise rotated by alpha to obtain a position 3 (x3, y3); 7, the arm 1 is anticlockwise rotated by 2*alpha, and the arm 2 is clockwise rotated by 2*alpha to obtain a position 4 (x4, y4); and 8, a value described in the specification and a length L1 of the arm 1 are solved due to the fact that an angle value of theta 2 is not changed.
source_title: Method for calculating arm length of SCARA robot

abstract: The invention discloses a control system for a radio-frequency connector assembling robot. The control system comprises multiple visual sensors, an ultrasonic sensor, a six-dimensional wrist force sensor and a clamping device. A variable-piece type fingertip force sensor is installed on the side face of the finger of the clamping device. The visual sensors are connected with a master control computer through an image collecting card. The six-dimensional wrist force sensor and the variable-piece type fingertip force sensor are connected with the master control computer through the signal collecting card via the same controller. The controller can transmit instructions issued by the master control computer to the variable-piece type fingertip force sensor, and the ultrasonic sensor is connected with the master control computer through a connecting clamping opening. The control system has the beneficial effects that global visual rough measuring, local vision, ultrasonic sensor precise measuring, wrist force sensor fine adjustment and fingertip force sensor clamping are used for improving the perception capability and the information treatment capability of the double-arm assembling robot; and the control system is simple in structure, convenient to achieve, the problem of merging complex information of multiple sensors is avoided, and the executing efficiency of a radio-frequency connector assembling system is improved.
source_title: Control system for radio-frequency connector assembling robot

abstract: The invention discloses a cyclic motion control method and device for a double-arm robot. The method and the device are suitable for a robot with a left mechanical arm and a right mechanical arm. The method comprises the steps: setting a performance index of a left-arm robot and a performance index of a right-arm robot, and minimizing the two performance indexes at the same time to obtain a motion performance index, generating a control scheme of cyclic motion of a protrusion level layer based on the motion performance index; generating a left constraint inequality of the left-arm robot and a right constraint inequality of the right-arm robot; based on the left constraint inequality and the right constraint inequality, converting the control scheme of the cyclic motion of the protrusion level layer into a standard quadratic programming problem, and calling a preset quadratic programming solver to solve the problem; and obtaining a solving result generated by the preset quadratic programming solver, and driving the left mechanical arm and the right mechanical arm of the robot to circularly move according to the solving result. Circulating motion control of the double-arm robot can be achieved.
source_title: Cyclic motion control method and device for double-arm robot

abstract: The invention discloses a two-arm robot motion planning method, system and device for a strong coupling scene, and the main content is as follows: constructing a strong coupling two-arm robot closed chain system kinematic model, giving a group of mechanical arm # imgabs0 # joint configuration, and outputting a joint configuration set corresponding to another mechanical arm # imgabs1 # through the kinematic model, therefore, the planning space dimension is greatly reduced; according to a master-slave batch self-adaptive planning strategy, a mechanical arm # imgabs2 # carries out active batch self-adaptive path planning, and then a mechanical arm # imgabs3 # carries out passive batch self-adaptive path planning based on the strong-coupling double-arm closed-chain system kinematic model; and carrying out pre-motion safety check on the double-arm robot to ensure absolute safety of double-arm cooperative motion in the closed chain operation process. The problems of real-time performance and safety in a strong coupling scene are effectively solved, and reliable technical support is provided for industrial-grade double-arm cooperation.
source_title: Double-arm robot motion planning method, system and equipment facing strong coupling scene

abstract: The invention relates to a method for planning a coordinated path of a dual-arm space robot based on random sampling. According to the method, an initial feasible path of a dual-arm end effector in aCartesian space is planned through an RRT* algorithm, the initial path generated by the RRT* algorithm is smoothed by utilizing four splines, and a smooth path suitable for robot execution is obtainedby first-order, second-order and third-order differential continuous constraints satisfying the splines and the initial speed, end speed and acceleration constraints of the end effector of a mechanical arm. The method has the beneficial effects that the safe and feasible initial path of the tail end is quickly generated in an unstructured environment by utilizing the RRT* algorithm, the initial path generated by the RRT* is smoothed by utilizing four splines, the robot is ensured to execute the planned path in a good state, and the physical limit constraint of the mechanical arm is considered. A simulation result illustrates the effectiveness of the proposed coordinated path planning method. The method has important significance on motion planning of the mechanical arm, especially on capture path planning for a failed satellite.
source_title: Method for planning coordinated path of dual-arm space robot based on random sampling

abstract: The invention discloses a redundant double-arm collaborative robot, and belongs to the field of intelligent robots. The robot comprises a two-degree-of-freedom cradle head, a seven-degree-of-freedom mechanical left arm, a seven-degree-of-freedom mechanical right arm, a waist rotating unit, an omni-directional movable base plate, an upper-layer rotating part supporting device and an upper-layer electric mounting box; and the left arm and the right arm are the same in structure, each arm has seven degrees of freedom, the overall size of the robot is slightly lower than that of an adult, and thewhole body has 20 degrees of freedom. According to the redundant double-arm collaborative robot, on the basis of a traditional robot, the omni-directional movable base plate is reasonably designed, the waist rotating unit is reasonably arranged, so that the moving range of the robot and the working space of the double-arm cooperation are expanded; and based on a stricter modular design concept, each component module is independent, and the processing and assembling are simpler.
source_title: Redundant double-arm collaborative robot

abstract: A robotic surgical system comprising at least two robotic arms having co-ordinate systems known relative to each other, one of the arms carrying an X-ray source, and the other an imaging detector plate. The arms are disposed to enable an image to be generated on the region of interest of a subject. One of the arms can additionally or alternatively carry a surgical tool or tool holder, such that the pose of the tool is known in the same co-ordinate system as that of an image generated by the X-ray source and detector. Consequently, any surgical procedure planned on such an X-ray image can be executed by the tool with high accuracy, since the tool position is known in the image frame of reference. This enables the surgeon to accurately position his tool in a real-time image without the need for an external registration procedure.
source_title: VERSATILE MULTI-ARM ROBOTIC SURGICAL SYSTEM

abstract: The invention discloses a double-arm robot. The double-arm robot comprises a base and a body arranged on the base, wherein lifting mechanisms are arranged on the two sides of the robot body respectively, mechanical arms are mounted on the lifting mechanisms respectively, and the lifting mechanisms ascend and descend vertically to drive the mechanical arms to move vertically; each mechanical arm comprises a first movable unit and a second movable unit; each first movable unit comprises a first driving motor and a first moving arm, and each first driving motor drives the corresponding first moving arm to move horizontally; and each second movable unit comprises a second driving motor and a second moving arm, and each second driving motor drives the corresponding second moving arm to move horizontally. By arranging lifting devices, control over the movement of the mechanical arms in the longitudinal direction is achieved; control over the movement in the horizontal direction is achieved by arranging the mechanical arms; in this way, control over the movement of the mechanical arms in a space system is achieved; and the problem that an existing assembly-type double-arm robot sets a specific movement mode according to work content and cannot change the movement mode according to the use purpose is solved.
source_title: Double-arm robot

abstract: The invention provides a double-arm robot coordinated motion planning method under multiple constraints, which belongs to the field of robots, and comprises the following steps of: establishing a task constraint mathematical model according to a double-arm robot coordinated operation task demand and a target by acquiring target information and a current state of a robot; a quadratic penalty function method is introduced to convert end effector position closed-chain equality constraint relations in two-arm coordinated operation tasks in different scenes into a target function, and a multi-constraint optimization problem of two-arm robot coordinated motion planning is constructed; solving by adopting a model prediction path integral control method based on an information theory to obtain a double-arm coordinated motion optimal track meeting a multi-constraint task requirement; and finally, applying the optimal trajectory of the two-arm coordinated motion to the robot simulation operation task. According to the method, the working efficiency and the stability of the double-arm robot during completion of a smart coordinated motion planning task can be effectively improved, and a new theoretical and method basis is provided for practical application of the double-arm robot in a complex scene.
source_title: Coordinated motion planning method for double-arm robot under multiple constraints

abstract: The invention discloses a multifunctional double-arm education robot. The multifunctional double-arm education robot comprises a base, wherein an education robot body is arranged on the base, and a plurality of swing arms are arranged on the education robot body; a control mainboard, a music playing module, a wireless transmission module, a smoke sensor, a temperature sensor, a humidity sensor and a pressure sensor are arranged in the education robot, and the smoke sensor, the music playing module, the wireless transmission module, the humidity sensor, the temperature sensor and the pressure sensor are all electrically connected with the control mainboard and controlled by the control mainboard; a mounting chamber is formed in the base, and a double-shaft motor is fixedly arranged in the mounting chamber; cleaning assemblies are fixed to motor shafts of the double-shaft motor, and the cleaning assemblies extend to the external environment of the base; and a thickening part is formed on one side of the education robot body. The multifunctional double-arm education robot is diversified in function and convenient to operate.
source_title: Multifunctional double-arm education robot

abstract: The invention discloses a double-arm space robot adhesion and capture control method, which is characterized in that the double-arm space robot adhesion and capture control method is used for a double-arm space robot system. The double-arm space robot system comprises a double-arm space robot platform (1), a first space mechanical arm (2), an end effector (4) of the first space mechanical arm (2), a second space mechanical arm (3) and an end effector (5) of the second space mechanical arm (3), and the adhesion and capture control method for the double-arm space robot comprises the following steps that 1, an adhesion concept is put forward, and an adhesion and capture mode of the double-arm space robot is designed; 2, a coordinate system is established, and dynamics modeling of the two-arm space robot is completed; 3, designing an autonomous path planning algorithm in adhesion capture; step 4, completing the design of an adhesion capture controller by using a contact force control strategy; and 5, carrying out closed-loop numerical simulation, and verifying the effectiveness of double-arm adhesion capture.
source_title: Double-arm space robot adhesion capture control method

abstract: The invention provides a target detection deduplication positioning method and system for a double-arm cooperative wheel-tracked robot, and relates to the technical field of target detection deduplication positioning of robots, the method incorporates three-dimensional information into a deduplication algorithm, so that the target position can be judged more accurately, the same target is prevented from being repeatedly detected by multiple sensors, the data volume is reduced, and the detection efficiency is improved. The target positioning error is effectively reduced, and the reliability of subsequent grabbing operation is improved; through combination of accurate three-dimensional point cloud data provided by a laser radar, the limitation of a depth camera in a complex environment is effectively made up, and the target identification capability is significantly improved. A unified coordinate conversion framework based on a radar coordinate system is introduced, the precision and dynamic adaptability of target positioning are enhanced, the defects of a traditional coordinate conversion method in a dynamic environment are overcome, efficient grabbing operation of a mechanical arm is supported, and the dynamic response capacity of the robot is improved.
source_title: Target detection de-weight positioning method and system for double-arm cooperative wheel-tracked robot

abstract: The invention discloses a two-arm robot cooperative motion control method based on an MATD3 algorithm, and the method comprises the steps: 1, building a mechanical arm model for a two-arm robot system, and enabling the mechanical arm model to comprise a robot kinematics equation and a kinetic equation; 2, establishing an MATD3 algorithm network, and designing a network structure and a parameter updating rule; 3, training an MATD3 network model oriented to cooperative control of the two-arm robots, selecting a state space, an action space and a reward function of each agent, and giving a network training process; and step 4, carrying out cooperative motion control on the two-arm robot based on MATD3, and carrying out cooperative motion control on the two-arm robot based on the trained algorithm model. According to the method, cooperative motion control of the double-arm robot can be achieved, and compared with a traditional algorithm, the calculation complexity is greatly reduced, and meanwhile the control efficiency and reliability are improved.
source_title: Two-arm robot cooperative motion control method based on MATD3 algorithm

abstract: The mounting robot comprises a shield (1) wherein are hinged two arms comprised of hollow or cup-shaped members (2, 3) carrying hands (4) of which the fingers are also hollow. The members are a copy of the arm portions, the phalanx of the hand and the fingers comprise articulations (40, 42, 44, 46, 47) which are approximately coaxial with the articulation axes of human members, when an operator is connected to the robot members. A stroke detector and a drive member are associated to each articulation. The motions executed by the operator are transformed by the detectors into electric signals which are stored in a memory. Said stored signals are used for the control of the drive members to repeat the motion. Thereby, the robot may execute the same gripping operations and the same mounting operations as those effected by the operator during programming.
source_title: MOUNTING ROBOT

abstract: A dual arm robot assembly has two arms each having a set of joint/link pairs that, in conjunction with an actuator assembly, define at least three degrees of freedom to provide independent horizontal translation and rotation of a distalmost link. A vertical motion mechanism is also provided.
source_title: Dual arm robot

abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses a double-arm robot control method and device, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a kinematics model and a dynamics model of a constructed double-arm robot; current motion state information of an end effector of the double-arm robot is obtained in real time based on the kinematic model, and potential collision information of the double-arm robot in the working space is determined based on the kinematic model and the current motion state information; based on the current motion state information, the potential collision information and a pre-constructed trajectory generation model, generating a target motion trajectory sequence of the double-arm robot within a preset duration; and converting the target motion trail sequence into a joint motion control instruction of the double-arm robot based on a closed-loop control algorithm, and controlling the double-arm cooperative motion of the double-arm robot based on the joint motion control instruction. By means of the technical scheme, control over the double-arm robot can be accurately and conveniently achieved, collision of the double arms is avoided, and the generation efficiency is improved.
source_title: Double-arm robot control method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium

abstract: A multimodal shared telerobotic system and method for a three-arm space robot, the system at least includes a local-site system, a communication module, and a remote-site system, where the local-site system includes two force-feedback haptic devices for left and right hands, a microphone array, and upper computer software; the remote-site system includes two robotic arms provided with end-effectors, an observation arm with a stereo camera installed at an end thereof, two force sensors, a vision unit and lower computer software; an operator can control the two robotic arms of the robot outside a cabin for performing operations, and control the observation arm to obtain a better local view; and a multimodal telerobotic control method of pose control, voice control, and force control is integrated with the robot's autonomous control through a shared control algorithm.
source_title: MULTIMODAL SHARED TELEROBOTIC SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR THREE-ARM SPACE ROBOT

abstract: The invention provides a detection operation device for a FAST feed source supporting cable, and belongs to the field of robots. The problems that cables, cables and optical cables are difficult to observe and the service life of the mechanical arm is prone to being affected are solved. The robot comprises a motion execution device, a visual acquisition device and a controller, the motion execution device comprises a cooperative double-arm mounting and fixing assembly and two mechanical arm assemblies, and the two mechanical arm assemblies are symmetrically arranged on the left side and the right side of the cooperative double-arm mounting and fixing assembly; a visual acquisition device is arranged at the tail end of each mechanical arm assembly, the two visual acquisition devices cooperatively act to track a cable and an optical cable in real time, the cooperative double-arm mounting and fixing assembly comprises two adsorption assemblies, and each adsorption assembly is used for adsorbing the mechanical arm assembly on the corresponding side in a non-working state. And the mechanical arm assembly and the visual acquisition device are electrically connected with the controller. The device is mainly used for cable detection.
source_title: Detection operation device for FAST feed source supporting cable

abstract: The invention relates to a double-arm picking robot control system and method based on neurodynamics, and belongs to the technical field of mechanical arm control. The system is composed of a moving platform, a left multi-joint mechanical arm, a right multi-joint mechanical arm and a central control system. The method comprises the following steps: S1, acquiring sensor data in real time; s2, identifying a picking target and calculating the position of the picking target; s3, calculating a current self state; s4, task decomposition is conducted, and expected states of the mobile platform and the tail ends of the two multi-joint mechanical arms are obtained; s5, building a dynamic neural network solver and performing training; s6, loading the dynamic neural network solver to a central control system; and S7, calculating a control strategy by using the trained dynamic neural network solver, and driving a servo motor to control and execute a picking task. According to the method, the dynamic neural network solver adopting the gradient descent method with speed compensation is innovatively designed, and accurate control over the zero position error can be theoretically achieved.
source_title: Double-arm picking robot control system and method based on neurodynamics

abstract: The invention belongs to the field of master-slave teleoperation in an exoskeleton robot technology, and particularly relates to a tendon transmission force feedback shoulder-elbow exoskeleton which is bilaterally symmetrical to form a double-arm structure. The forearm grip is fixedly installed at one end of the elbow joint assembly, and the other end of the elbow joint assembly is fixedly connected with the shoulder joint assembly. The shoulder joint assembly has the freedom degrees of shoulder forward extension and backward contraction, shoulder inward rotation and outward rotation and shoulder abduction and adduction in sequence; the shoulder joint assembly can be selectively and fixedly connected with the bearing system or other platforms; a big arm bandage assembly is fixedly installed between the elbow joint assembly and the shoulder joint assembly. The device has the advantages of being portable, wearable, low in motion inertia, high in compatibility, high in control flexibility and the like, and can be widely applied to the field of high-immediacy exoskeleton teleoperation and the field of motion rehabilitation and detection.
source_title: Tendon transmission force feedback shoulder and elbow exoskeleton

abstract: The invention belongs to the field of a magic cube robot and particularly discloses an electromagnetic double-arm magic cube solving robot and a control method thereof. The robot comprises a first electromagnetic arm unit, a second electromagnetic arm unit, a recognition unit and a control unit, wherein the first electromagnetic arm unit and the second electromagnetic arm unit are the same in structure and are arranged in a bilateral symmetry mode, the first electromagnetic arm unit and the second electromagnetic arm unit each comprise a motor, a manipulator, an electromagnet fastening barrel,an electromagnet, an electromagnet push rod and a spring and are used for completing rotating and grabbing actions, the recognition unit is arranged between the first electromagnetic arm unit and thesecond electromagnetic arm unit, the control unit is used for controlling movement of the first electromagnetic arm unit and the second electromagnetic arm unit. The robot has the advantages that electromagnetic drive is used as a power source, the manipulator is driven to complete grabbing action and releasing action through up-down movement of a movable iron core in the power-on and power-off processes of an electromagnet, the robot has advantages of high response and small size, and a problem that the clamping force is unstable due to the fact that the air pressure of an air cylinder arm is reduced in the using process can be solved.
source_title: Electromagnetic double-arm magic cube solving robot and control method thereof

abstract: The invention discloses a trajectory planning method and system based on a double-arm collaborative robot, and belongs to the technical field of power distribution station inspection, and the method specifically comprises the steps: building a three-dimensional map of a power distribution station through a GIS system; the method comprises the following steps: generating a plurality of to-be-inspected tasks according to working contents of inspection robots, sorting the to-be-inspected tasks according to priorities to obtain a first sequence, and formulating inspection routes of the plurality of inspection robots based on the first sequence to obtain a first inspection route; establishing a task quantity prediction model, substituting the task quantity prediction model to judge whether the electric quantity of the inspection robot meets the current inspection task requirement, and if so, performing inspection work according to the first inspection route; and if not, obtaining predicted residual electric quantity information of the plurality of inspection robots, and formulating a final inspection route in combination with the residual electric quantity information of the plurality of inspection robots. The continuity of the inspection task is ensured, and the inspection efficiency is improved.
source_title: Track planning method and system based on double-arm collaborative robot

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of casting machinery, and discloses a double-arm casting soup feeding robot which comprises a robot body, the robot body comprises a base, a main force arm, an auxiliary force arm and a connecting rod assembly driving a soup ladle assembly to rotate, the connecting rod assembly comprises a long connecting rod, and the long connecting rod is parallel to the auxiliary force arm. The two ends of the long connecting rod are rotationally connected with a first short connecting rod and a second short connecting rod respectively, one end of the first short connecting rod is coaxially connected to the main force arm and the auxiliary force arm, and one end of the second short connecting rod is connected with the soup ladle assembly and is coaxially arranged with the auxiliary force arm. The soup ladle assembly can stably move along a set path through matched movement of the main force arm and the auxiliary force arm, meanwhile, the rotating process of ladling up and pouring soup is independently achieved through the connecting rod assembly, and the soup feeding speed and the stability in the soup feeding process are greatly improved.
source_title: Double-arm casting soup feeding robot

abstract: The invention provides a series-parallel double-arm transfer robot kinematics parameter accurate calibration method based on a UPF-RBF combined model, and the method comprises the steps: firstly constructing a kinematics model and a kinematics geometric error identification model, and then measuring the real position of an end effector through a three-dimensional laser tracker; the position error vector is input into a UKF algorithm to obtain a geometric parameter deviation initial value, and the UPF takes a UKF parameter identification result as a priori condition and inputs the UKF parameter identification result into the PF for robot geometric parameter re-calibration to preliminarily improve the positioning precision of the hybrid double-arm robot; designing an RBF neural network model for indirect compensation for non-geometric errors with interleaving coupling and strong randomness; a self-adaptive link is designed for online correction according to the situation that variable value disturbance exists in actual carrying operation; compared with a traditional parameter calibration method, the combined model provided by the invention effectively improves the positioning precision of the series-parallel double-arm robot, and has certain self-adaptive adjustment capability.
source_title: Series-parallel double-arm transfer robot kinematics parameter accurate calibration method based on UPF-RBF combination model

abstract: The invention discloses a trajectory planning method for real-time collision avoidance of a redundant double-arm service robot. The trajectory planning method comprises the steps of analyzing the shortest distance between a main arm connecting rod and an environmental obstacle; analyzing the relation between the main arm connecting rod and an obstacle when an auxiliary arm connecting rod is takenas the obstacle; analyzing the relation between the auxiliary arm connecting rod and the environmental obstacle; and analyzing the relation between the auxiliary arm connecting rod and the obstacle when the main arm connecting rod is taken as the obstacle. The trajectory planning method is simple and practicable, easy to operate, and capable of changing obstacle avoidance speed in real time; the movement of each joint of the redundant double-arm service robot is continuous and stable; and it can be guaranteed that the nearest distance between the connecting rods of double arms of the robot andthe nearest distance between each connecting rod and the environment obstacle are always larger than the set safety distance.
source_title: Trajectory planning method for real-time collision avoidance of redundant double-arm service robot and stable operation method

abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To obtain an offset rotational joint unit with a rotation correction mechanism, applicable for a double arm mechanism of care giving assist robot or the like, which can perform bending action of a two-dimensional surface by only a rotational mechanism and can cope with high load weighting. SOLUTION: One set of offset rotational joint unit 4 is constituted by a first arm 1, a rotation correction arm 2 driven to rotate with an axis of this first arm 1 serving as the center, and a second arm 3 driven to rotate with an axis diagonal to this rotation correction arm 2 serving as the center. A rotation correction joint mechanism part 5 connecting the first arm 1 and the rotation correction arm 2 and an offset rotation joint mechanism part 6 connecting the rotation correction arm 2 and the second arm 3 are driven by a single motor 12, by reverse rotation with the rotation correction joint mechanism part synchronized according to rotation of the offset rotation joint mechanism part, the second arm performs bending action in a two-dimensional surface relating to the first arm by only a rotational mechanism.
source_title: OFFSET ROTATIONAL JOINT UNIT WITH ROTATION CORRECTION MECHANISM

abstract: Disclosed is a method for controlling both robot arms, which comprises: a grasping step to grasp the axial position difference between the tip ends of one arm and the other arm; a producing step to produce virtual power at the tip end of one arm based on the position difference grasped; and a converting step to convert the produced virtual power into driving torque for each joint of one arm using a Jacobian matrix. [Reference numerals] (AA) Start; (BB) End; (S100) Grasping step; (S200) Producing step; (S300) Converting step; (S400) Applying step
source_title: METHOD FOR CONTROLLING TWO ARMS OF ROBOT

abstract: The laser welding device comprises an unit (10) for creating and/or guiding laser beam, an assistance unit (11), which provides an assistance function for a welding operation by the laser unit at a workpiece (12, 13, 14, 15), and a robot unit (16), which comprises a robotic arm, at which a part of the laser unit is arranged for the welding operation and by which the laser beam from the laser unit guides over the workpiece. The robot unit comprises another two robotic arms for the assistance unit. A control and/or a regulation unit is provided to coordinate the robotic arms. The laser welding device comprises an unit (10) for creating and/or guiding laser beam, an assistance unit (11), which provides an assistance function for a welding operation by the laser unit at a workpiece (12, 13, 14, 15), and a robot unit (16), which comprises a robotic arm (17), at which a part of the laser unit is arranged for the welding operation and by which the laser beam produced and/or guided from the laser unit guides over the workpiece. The robot unit comprises another two robotic arms for the assistance unit. A control and/or a regulation unit is provided: to coordinate the robotic arms intended for the assistance unit during welding operation in a movement-technical manner; to coordinate the assistance unit with a movement of the robotic arms in a function-technical manner; and to position the robotic arms intended for the assistance unit alternately at the workpiece. The assistance unit comprises two clamping elements, which are arranged at one of the robotic arms intended for the assistance unit, a sensor, which is arranged at one of the robotic arms and is provided to detect the workpiece during and/or according to welding operation, and an addition element, which is arranged at one of the robotic arms and brings a welding agent to the workpieces during welding operation. An independent claim is included for a method for welding the workpiece by laser unit in a laser welding device.
source_title: Laser device for welding a workpiece, comprises an unit for creating and/or guiding laser beam, an unit providing assistance function for a welding operation by the laser unit at the workpiece, and a robot unit comprising a robotic arm

abstract: The invention discloses a robot track operation protection structure, and relates to the technical field of robots. The robot track operation protection structure comprises a robot body, the robot body is provided with two arms and two legs, the robot track operation protection structure further comprises crawler mechanisms and crawler driving mechanisms, one end of each arm and one end of each leg are respectively provided with one crawler mechanism and one crawler driving mechanism, and each crawler driving mechanism drives one crawler mechanism; and each crawler belt mechanism comprises twoside edge protection plates, two belt guide wheels arranged between the two side edge protection plates, a crawler belt used for connecting the two belt guide wheels, a connecting joint arranged on the two side edge protection plates, a first pressing mechanism arranged on one side of the connecting joint, and a second pressing mechanism arranged between the two belt guide wheels, and the secondpressing mechanism is connected with the two side edge protection plates. The safety is high, the crawler belts can be protected, and the service life of the crawler belts is prolonged.
source_title: Robot track operation protection structure

abstract: The invention provides a double-arm up-and-down cooperative flower drawing structure, a flower drawing method and a flower drawing system.The structure comprises a mechanical arm A and a mechanical arm B. The mechanical arm A is located below the mechanical arm B. Compared with the structural rotation type of an arm A and an arm B of an existing coffee robot, the structural rotation type of the arm A and the structural rotation type of the arm B are in an inverted mode, and the arm A has the rotation freedom degree in the horizontal direction; the arm B has a rotational degree of freedom in the vertical direction; the arm A is detachably connected with a coffee cup, and the arm B is detachably connected with a milk cylinder. The structure rotation type of the arm A and the arm B is in an inverted mode, by redefining the pattern pulling operation track of the robot, up-down pattern pulling can be achieved, up-down pattern pulling tracks can be generated and are closer to the actual posture state of a coffee maker, the operation space is saved, the pulled pattern is better close to the effect of manual pattern pulling in the actual state, and the production efficiency is improved. Therefore, the pattern display form is stereoscopic, the 3D effect of the pattern drawing track of the robot is effectively enhanced, and the use experience of a user is greatly improved.
source_title: Double-arm up-and-down cooperative pattern drawing structure, pattern drawing method and pattern drawing system

abstract: A household robot is provided to sense the characteristics of a structure and the position of the robot in a real time basis and move an object through command. A household robot includes a driving wheel unit(2), arms(3), a camera(4), and a controller(5). The driving wheel unit is arranged beneath a main body(1) such that the driving wheel unit is movable in all directions. The arms are arranged on both sides of the main body so as to hold an object. The camera is arranged on the main body, and picks up characteristics of a structure in real time. The controller is arranged within the main body, and controls the driving wheel unit and both arms based on data sensed by the camera and moves the object. Each arm includes first to fifth shafts connected to the side surface of the main body such that the shafts are individually driven, and a hand arranged at one end of the fifth shaft such that the hand opens/closes through a hand driving unit.
source_title: HOUSEHOLD AFFAIRS ROBOT

abstract: The invention relates to robots, in particular to a machining and assembling process of a travelling mechanism of a dual-arm robot. The process includes: fixing a travelling beam of the travelling mechanism onto a platform, and assembling a plurality of joints of the robot to be complete; hinging one end of each joint to a travelling component; hinging the other end of each joint to one end of a connecting beam; fixedly connecting the other end of each connecting beam to the travelling beam through bolts; assembling a speed reducing mechanism to each joint. The robot is driven by the joints to move in a three-dimensional space, a first shaft and a second shaft are assembled to a special shell of each joint, the shell and the connecting arm can be driven to rotate horizontally by rotation of the first shaft, the connecting arm can be driven to rotate vertically through the second shaft, a moving component can be driven to rotate vertically through a third shaft, and three-dimensional motion of the moving component is realized through rotation of the three shafts; during implement, machining is simple, cost is low, assembly is convenient and quick.
source_title: Machining and assembling process of travelling mechanism of dual-arm robot

abstract: A system for assembling a vehicle platform includes a robotic assembly system having at least two robotic arms, a vision system capturing images of an assembly frame, and a control system configured to control the robotic assembly system to assemble the vehicle platform based on images from the vision system, force feedback from the at least two robotic arms, and a component location model. The control system is further configured to identify assembly features of a first component and a second component of the vehicle platform from the images, operate the robotic arms to orient the first component and the second component to respective nominal positions based on the images and the component location model, and operate the robotic arms to assemble the first component to the second component based on the force feedback.
source_title: Method and system for fixtureless assembly of a vehicle platform

abstract: The invention discloses a bidirectional grape picking method and device, and relates to the technical field of fruit and vegetable picking. The method comprises the steps of inputting a detection image into a target detection model to identify a target fruit coordinate, executing a single-side single-arm working mode and a single-side double-arm working mode for an unshielded fruit area, and executing a double-arm cooperative working mode for a shielded grape area. The device comprises a base and a mechanical arm, and sliding tables are installed on the two sides of the base; a storage bin and a control system are mounted on the base; the number of the mechanical arms is two, the two mechanical arms are installed at the moving ends of the two sliding tables correspondingly, and clamping jaws and depth cameras are installed at the tail ends of the mechanical arms. The two sliding tables, the two mechanical arms, the two clamping jaws and the two depth cameras are all connected with a control system. The working direction and the working mode of the grape picking mechanical arm can be flexibly changed, the utilization rate of the mechanical arm and the picking success rate when a picking point is shielded are improved, and the picking efficiency of the grape picking robot is improved.
source_title: Bidirectional picking method and device for grapes

abstract: The invention provides a two-arm operation imitation learning method and device, a storage medium, electronic equipment and a computer program product. The method comprises the following steps: obtaining human two-arm operation demonstration data and robot two-arm operation demonstration data; performing space-time alignment on the human double-arm operation demonstration data and the robot double-arm operation demonstration data to obtain human double-arm operation demonstration data after space-time alignment and robot double-arm operation demonstration data after space-time alignment; and on the basis of the human double-arm operation demonstration data after space-time alignment and the robot double-arm operation demonstration data after space-time alignment, track data and action control data of double-arm operation are acquired through a pre-trained imitation learning network. According to the technical scheme, the defects of poor data diversity and weak generalization ability are overcome while the data acquisition cost is reduced.
source_title: Double-arm operation imitation learning method and device and storage medium

abstract: The invention discloses an article grabbing planning method and system which are used for improving the service capability of a double-arm mobile robot. The article grabbing planning method disclosed by the invention comprises the following steps: a double-arm mobile robot obtains a voice command, obtains a task needing to be executed according to the voice command, and uploads the task needing to be executed to a background decision system; the background decision-making system determines a target sub-region marking position point according to a task needing to be executed; the background decision-making system plans a driving route for arriving at the marked position point of the target sub-region and sends the driving route to the double-arm mobile robot; or the double-arm mobile robot receives the target sub-region mark position point sent by the background decision system and plans the driving route to the target sub-region mark position point; the double-arm mobile robot goes to the target subarea to mark a position point, a visual detection function is started, and a target object is searched; the double-arm mobile robot determines a second position where the target object needs to be grabbed according to the visual detection information; and the double-arm mobile robot adjusts the position of the double-arm mobile robot to reach the second position, the pose of the mechanical arm is inversely solved, and the target object is grabbed. The invention further provides an article grabbing planning system.
source_title: Article grabbing planning method and system

abstract: The invention discloses a visual servo double-arm robot migration simulation learning method from simulation to reality, which comprises the following steps: S110, constructing a virtual simulation scene according to a real task scene, and establishing a relation between the virtual simulation scene and the real task scene; s120, the collected teaching mechanical arm and executing mechanical arm operation data are replayed and optimized in the virtual simulation scene, so that a data set used for final training is constructed; s130, a deep imitation learning network is designed and achieved, input of the deep imitation learning network comprises visual data obtained in the real task scene and state data of all joint motors of the teaching mechanical arm, and output of the deep imitation learning network is predicted states of all joint motors of the execution mechanical arm at the next moment; and S140, migrating the fully trained and converged deep imitation learning network from a virtual simulation scene to a double-arm robot in a real task scene. According to the invention, the exploration efficiency and generalization ability of the two-arm robot learning network are improved.
source_title: Visual servo double-arm robot migration simulation learning method from simulation to reality

abstract: The invention discloses a double-arm space robot inverse kinematics solving method integrating trunk height constraints, and relates to the technical field of space robots. The method sequentially comprises the steps that a geometry-based kinematics model of the double-arm space robot is established, a trunk virtual position formula is established, a trunk virtual pose is calculated according to the input trunk constraint height, the input expected pose is converted into the expected pose under a single arm, and a single-branch-arm inverse kinematics solver is called to calculate the joint angle and integrate the joint angle. A trunk height constraint problem is converted into an unconstrained two-single-arm inverse kinematics problem, the problem solving dimension is reduced, a parallel computing strategy can be adopted, when the double-arm space robot executes a task, the trunk and a space mechanism are kept at the specified height, and it is ensured that the task is safely and reliably executed.
source_title: Inverse kinematics solving method for double-arm space robot integrating trunk height constraint

abstract: The present invention relates to a control algorithm for a medical robot arm mounted on a mobile cart. According to the present invention, in any position, any situation, and any environment, the robot arm can execute a received work command. The control algorithm of the robot arm according to the present invention includes the following steps of: confirming, by two arms, a current position of a work subject; checking a current position of a worker; checking a current position of a work assistant; determining which of the two arms is given priority in a current status; commanding a work corresponding to the priority to the arm assigned with the priority; calculating whether the two arms collide with each other in a work intended by the two arms; and terminating the work by the command of the worker.
source_title: Control algorithm of medical robotic arms attached to autonomous cart

abstract: A wearable robotic system (100) assists a wearer (170) in performing manual tasks. One or more robotic arms (110A, HOB) are mounted to the wearer, and a sensor (140A, 140B, 140C) monitors the orientation(s) (e.g., position and movement) of the wearer's upper body and one or both arms (175A, 175B). A controller (120) detects a task being performed by the wearer based on the orientation(s) as indicated by the orientation sensors. In response, the controller causes the robotic arm to perform an action independent of the orientation(s) of the wearer's arms and complementary to the task, thereby aiding the wearer to accomplish the detected task.
source_title: WEARABLE ROBOT ASSISTING MANUAL TASKS

abstract: The invention provides a synchronous exoskeleton mechanical arm, and belongs to the technical field of bionic robots. The synchronous exoskeleton mechanical arm comprises a supporting device and two arms which are symmetrically installed on the two sides of the supporting device, each arm comprises an upper arm, a forearm and a transmission device, each upper arm is hinged to the corresponding forearm, each transmission device comprises an upper arm sleeve connected to a human arm in a sleeving mode, a transmission shaft installed on the corresponding upper arm and a transmission mechanism installed on the corresponding forearm, each upper arm sleeve is rotatably connected with the corresponding transmission shaft, and one end of each transmission shaft is connected with the correspondingtransmission mechanism.
