According to the synchronous exoskeleton mechanical arm, the human arm is taken as a power source, power is transmitted to the upper arms and the forearms through the transmission shafts and the transmission mechanisms, therefore, human arc actions are synchronously completed, supporting and moving assistance is provided for a human body, few materials are consumed, and operation is easy.
source_title: Synchronous exoskeleton mechanical arm

abstract: The invention discloses a task adjustment method and device for a double-arm robot, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps that current environment information of the double-arm robot in the current detection stage is detected; generating an expected motion parameter of the double-arm robot in the current detection stage based on the current environment information; according to the actual motion parameters and the expected motion parameters, current motion deviation information of the double-arm robot in the current detection stage is determined; based on the current motion deviation information and the current environment information, joint control parameters used for adjusting deviation of all joints of the double-arm robot are determined through the target model, and the joint control parameters are used for generating expected motion parameters of the next detection stage in combination with environment information corresponding to the next detection stage of the double-arm robot. By the adoption of the scheme, the double-arm robot can flexibly adjust deviation of all joints based on dynamic changes of the working environment, and the adaptability of the double-arm robot to the dynamic changes of the environment is improved.
source_title: Task adjustment method and device of double-arm robot, electronic equipment and storage medium

abstract: The invention discloses a coordination graph double-arm cooperative control method based on fusion of human body kinematics constraints. Double-arm cooperative control is carried out from an action level and an operation task level at the same time; in the action cooperation level, a robot cooperation track is obtained through a teleoperation teaching technology, and human actions are mapped to arobot end through a quaternion attitude trajectory mapping method and are optimally stored; a coordination graph is generated according to the trajectory collision situation, the coordination graph takes the operation time of the left arm and the right arm as the horizontal and vertical coordinates, the robots colliding with each other in the graph are set to be black, the robots without collisionare set to be white, and a complete coordination graph is formed; trajectory planning in the coordination graph is carried out by adopting a mode of combining an RRT-Connect algorithm with a trajectory optimization algorithm in an open source action planning library to complete double-arm cooperation of the action level; and after the collision-free cooperation pair operation is completed, the collision cooperation pair cooperates according to the previous cooperation law calculation result to complete the cooperation operation, so that the operation time is shortest, and the operation efficiency is maximized.
source_title: Coordination graph double-arm cooperative control method based on fusion of human body kinematics constraints

abstract: The invention discloses a throat swab double-arm sampling robot and sampling method based on machine vision guidance. A robot system utilizes an industrial depth camera for acquiring cloud informationof an RGB-D depth point, oral space environment is recognized and processed, a deep learning algorithm is adopted, three-dimensional coordinates of a tongue tip and a throat deep part are determinedto serve as expected coordinates of two arms, collaborative motion planning of moving of the two arms is completed on the basis of a moveit function package, a robot control system performs wireless communication with ROS on the basis of ROS system development through human-computer interaction control, and remote control and real-time monitoring functions are realized. According to the robot, medical staff can be prevented from making direct contact with infectious substances in a body of a patient, completion of a complex throat swab sampling process by the double-arm robot is monitored, high execution precision and success rate are guaranteed, and accidental risks such as an injury occurring in the sampling process of the patient are avoided.
source_title: Throat swab double-arm sampling robot and sampling method based on machine vision guidance

abstract: A door opening method and device are provided that can reduce the size of the installation location of a robot, as well as achieve a reduction in cycle time. In a dual arm robot, two arms are rotated by each of an shaft S1 and an shaft S2. As a result, a door opening action (Step ST2) is realized by rotation using the shaft S1. Then, a movement to enter an interior side of a door (91) in order to perform a bolt loosening action is realized by rotation using the shaft S1 and shaft S2. The movement in this case is movement such as to face the direction of the door (91). As a result, when moving to a door holding position (Step S26), the dual arm robot is at an attitude facilitating performing a bolt loosening action.
source_title: Vehicle body door opening method and device, door removing device and method, door holding device and method, and socket

abstract: The invention discloses a control method and device of a double-arm robot, the robot and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of robot control of the artificial intelligence technology. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a first operation task to be executed by the double-arm robot and corresponding environment information; based on the first operation task and the environment information, obtaining an object planned motion track and an object expected contact force corresponding to the first operation task; determining an expected joint moment meeting kinematics constraint and dynamics constraint based on an object planning motion track and an object expected contact force; and based on the expected joint torque, all joints of the double-arm robot are controlled to move so as to execute the first operation task. According to the method, the joint torque of the double-arm robot is planned on the kinematics constraint level and the dynamics constraint level based on the operation task, so that the double-arm robot can execute the operation task which focuses on the kinematics constraint level and the dynamics constraint level at the same time, and the application range of the double-arm robot is expanded.
source_title: Control method and device of double-arm robot, robot and storage medium

abstract: The invention discloses a nursing robot which is composed of a power system, a control system, a head, two arms, a body, legs and a chassis. The power system is connected with the head, the two arms, the body, the legs and the chassis, and the control system controls the power system to enable the head, the two arms and the body to move freely and enable the legs to bend freely; in the off-line nursing mode, a nursed person or an instruction sending person sets an instruction to the control system, and the robot is controlled to walk, support and sit so as to nurse a nursed person; and in the on-line nursing mode, imaging is carried out at the head, connected relatives and friends are displayed, video communication and remote communication are carried out, and the control system controls movement of the head, the two arms, the body, the legs and the chassis according to an instruction of the connected relatives and friends, actions of the remote relatives and friends are simulated, and the nursed person is remotely controlled to be nursed. The robot replaces a person for nursing, actions and expressions of a nursing person are simulated in real time, field conditions are captured and fed back to the nursing person, interactive communication and nursing are completed, the effect of being personally on the scene is achieved, and robot nursing is achieved.
source_title: Nursing robot

abstract: A jig is provided for aligning an upper end effector and a lower end effector of a dual arm robot of a substrate processing system. The jig is configured to accommodate the lower end effector and the upper end effector is aligned with the lower end effector using the jig. Specifically, the jig includes an upper top surface and an upper side surface, and a lower top surface separated from a lower bottom surface by a lower side surface. The upper side surface and the lower top surface couple to form a right angle. Lower end effector aligns with the jig by coupling with the lower top surface and the upper side surface. After alignment of the lower end effector, upper end effector aligns with lower end effector by coupling with the jig.
source_title: FRONT END ROBOT LEVELING JIG

abstract: As a method of teaching a dual-arm robot in which a teaching device is implemented as a virtual reality, the arm motion information of an operator moving the arm from a first point to a second point is collected when a joint rotation angle with respect to a plurality of joints of the virtual reality dual-arm robot to which the pose information is reflected is confirmed by using a three-dimensional coordinate system generated on the basis of the pose information of the operator. The collected arm motion information and a driving torque applied to a motor of the plurality of joints on the basis of the determined joint rotation angle are calculated, and a trajectory for movement of the robot arm from the first point to the second point is generated on the basis of the calculated driving torque. In addition, the teaching information of the robot arm is displayed according to the generated trajectory.
source_title: Apparatus and method for dual-arm robot teaching based on virtual reality

abstract: A robot in accordance with at least some embodiments of the present technology includes a torso having a superior portion, an inferior portion, and an intermediate portion therebetween. The robot further includes two legs connected to the torso via the inferior portion of the torso, two arms connected to the torso via the superior portion of the torso, and a protrusion also connected to the torso via the inferior portion of the torso and extending anteriorly from the torso. The robot is configured to move an object toward the torso at least partially via contact between the object and at least one of the arms. The robot is further configured to support a weight of the object at least partially via the protrusion while the robot ambulates via the legs.
source_title: Torso protrusion for robotic manipulation of objects and related technology

abstract: The invention discloses a wheel type double-arm indoor transport robot. The wheel type double-arm indoor transport robot comprises a head mechanism, a mechanical arm mechanism, a machine body mechanism and a base plate mechanism. The head mechanism can complete nod and head-shaking actions, the arrangement of freedom degree of the head mechanism enables the view of a binocular camera to be wider,and the robot is enabled to operate more stably; the mechanical arm mechanism is a six-axis mechanical arm, the flexibility and motion precision are higher, and the mechanical arm mechanism is suitable for the indoor complex working environment; the intelligence and automation degree of the wheel type double-arm indoor transport robot is improved through sensing and controlling assemblies carriedon the machine body mechanism; the human-machine interactivity is enhanced by being matched with an integral structural layout and the shape design of robot personification with a touch control paneland a sound pickup; and the base plate mechanism is a two driving wheel and two universal wheel type wheel type moving system, a damping device is matched with, and the base plate mechanism has unevenground environmental adaptive capability and certain self obstacle crossing capacity.
source_title: Wheel type double-arm indoor transport robot
